title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
english: The murder trial for legendary rapper Tupac Shakur has officially begun in Las Vegas, with prosecutors accusing former gang leader Duane 'Keffe D' Davis of orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting. While the prosecution claims Davis planned the attack as an act of retaliation, the defense argues that the case is based on a fabricated narrative and lacks concrete evidence. The trial seeks to finally resolve the decades-old mystery surrounding Shakur's death, which has long been linked to the intense hip-hop rivalries of the 1990s.
amharic: የታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር የነፍስ ማጥፋት ክስ ክርክር በላስ ቬጋስ ተጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞ የጋንግ መሪ የሆኑት ድዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ በ1996 የተፈጸመውን የቦዘኑ ጥቃት ያቀናበሩት እሳቸው ናቸው ሲል ይከሳል። የተከላካይ ጠበቆች በበኩላቸው ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ እና ማስረጃ የሌለው መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ክስ ለብዙ አስርት ዓመታት ያልተፈታውን የቱፓክ ሻኩርን ሞት ምስጢር ለማጣራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajjeechaa raappera beekamaa Tuupaak Shaakuur ilaalchisee mormiin seeraa magaalaa Laas Veegasitti eegalameera. Abbaan alangaa hogganaa garee badii duraanii Dueen 'Keef D' Deevis dhukaasa bara 1996 raawwatame sana akka qindeessan himatu. Gareen ittisaa gama isaaniitiin himannaan kun kan hin dhugoofneefi ragaa qabatamaa kan hin qabne ta'uu dubbatu. Seera qabeessummaan kun ajjeechaa Tuupaak Shaakuur kan waggoota soddoma darbanii as furmaata akka argatuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Two killed as gunman opens fire at Philippines high school, official says
english: A tragic shooting occurred at a high school in Zamboanga, Philippines, resulting in the deaths of two individuals. Local authorities confirmed that both victims were students, with one of them identified as the shooter. Police have secured the campus while investigations into the incident continue.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ዛምቦአንጋ ከተማ በሚገኝ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጠረ የተኩስ አደጋ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የከተማዋ አስተዳዳሪዎች እንደገለፁት ሁለቱም የሞቱት ተማሪዎች ሲሆኑ፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ አንዱ ተኳሹ ራሱ ነው። የፖሊስ ሰራዊት የትምህርት ቤቱን ግቢ ደህንነት የተቆጣጠረ ሲሆን ምርመራውም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Magaalaa Zaambo-aangaa kan Filippinsii keessatti mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa tokko keessatti dhukaasa banameen lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera. Abbootiin taayitaa akka ibsanitti, namoonni lamaan du'an barattoota yoo ta'an, isaan keessaa tokko kan dhukaasa bane sana akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera. Poolisiin nagaa mana barumsaa sanaa eegsisuu fi qorannoo geggeessuu itti fufeera.

title: Trump says talking to North Korea’s Kim makes the south safer
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reacted favorably to a proposal for diplomatic discussions. To support these talks and improve regional security, Trump decided to reduce military training exercises with South Korea. He maintains that direct communication with the North Korean leader is a key step toward ensuring safety in the area.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ለድርድር የቀረበላቸውን ጥያቄ በአዎንታዊ መልኩ እንደተቀበሉት ገልጸዋል። የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ሲባል ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር ይካሄዱ የነበሩ የጦር ልምምዶችን ለመቀነስ ወስነዋል። ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ውይይት ማድረግ ለቀጠናው ሰላም ወሳኝ እንደሆነም አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp, hogganaan Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Joong Un gaaffii marii isaan dhiheessaniif deebii gaarii kennuu isaa ibsaniiru. Nageenya naannichaa eeguuf jecha, Tiraamp leenjii waraanaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa wajjin taasisan hir’isuuf murteessaniiru. Hojiin marii hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa wajjin godhamu nageenya naannichaaf murteessaa akka ta’e himaniiru.

title: Large fire breaks out at fuel depot near Iraq’s Sulaimaniyah
english: A massive fire erupted at a fuel storage facility in the Tanjaro area near Sulaimaniyah, Iraq, causing significant destruction to dozens of tankers and millions of liters of fuel. While the blaze triggered several explosions and injured approximately 20 people, officials confirmed that all injuries were minor and no fatalities occurred. Authorities have since brought the fire under control, and experts do not anticipate a spike in local fuel prices as a result of the incident.
amharic: በኢራቅ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል በምትገኘው ሱለይማኒያ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የነዳጅ ማከማቻ ጣቢያ ላይ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። አደጋው በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ የነዳጅ ተሽከርካሪዎችን እና በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሊትር ነዳጅ ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ ወደ 20 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችም ቀላል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠር መቻላቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በዚህ አደጋ ምክንያት በክልሉ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ ለውጥ አይኖርም ብለው ይጠብቃሉ።
oromo: Irak, magaalaa Sulaayimaaniyaa biratti iddoo qulqulleeffannaa fi kuusaa boba'aa guddaa tokkotti ibidda hamaa ka'een miidhaan guddaan ga'eera. Ibidni kun konkolaattota boba'aa baatan hedduu fi boba'aa miliyoona sadii ol ta'u kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, namoonni 20 ta'an miidhamaniiru; garuu miidhaan isaanii salphaa akka ta'e ibsameera. Qondaalonni akka himanitti, ibidda kana to'achuun danda'ameera akkasumas rakkoo kanaan walqabatee gatiin boba'aa naannichaa akka hin daballee abdatameera.

title: Russia warns UK over supplying drones to Ukraine
english: Russia has threatened the UK with consequences after British drones were used in Ukrainian attacks on Russian military and industrial sites. The Russian government accused Britain of directly participating in the conflict by supplying these weapons. In response, the UK Ministry of Defence stated that it remains committed to helping Ukraine defend itself against Russia's ongoing invasion.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ ድሮኖች በሩሲያ ወታደራዊ እና ኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉ በኋላ ሩሲያ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ላይ የቅጣት እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች። የሩሲያ መንግሥት እነዚህን የጦር መሳሪያዎች በማቅረብ እንግሊዝ በቀጥታ በግጭቱ እየተሳተፈች ነው ሲል ከሷል። በምላሹም የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ዩክሬን እራሷን ከሩሲያ ወረራ እንድትከላከል ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Rusiyan xiyyaarota nama malee (drones) kan Biriiteenii Itoophiyaa keessatti bakkeewwan waraanaa fi industirii Raashiyaarratti haleellaa raawwachuuf gargaaran booda, Biriiteenirratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka dandeessu akeekkachiisteetti. Mootummaan Raashiyaa, Biriiteen meeshaalee kanneen dhiyeessuun waraana kana keessatti kallattiidhaan hirmaachaa jirti jechuun himateera. Gama biraatiin, Ministeerri Ittisa Biriiteen, Yukreeniin weerara Raashiyaarraa of ittisuuf deeggarsa gochuu irratti cimtee kan itti fuftu ta'uu ibseera.

title: BBC breaks down Trump's latest shift on North and South Korea
english: President Donald Trump announced a significant decrease in joint military drills between the United States and South Korea. He attributed this decision to his positive rapport with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The move also follows Trump's dissatisfaction with the South Korean government's refusal to support the U.S. position on Iran's denuclearization.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በደቡብ ኮሪያ መካከል የሚደረጉ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀንሱ አስታውቀዋል። ይህን ውሳኔ የወሰዱት ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ባላቸው ጥሩ ግንኙነት ምክንያት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ውሳኔው የመጣው ደቡብ ኮሪያ በአሜሪካ የኢራን የኒውክሌር መርሃ ግብር ላይ አቋሟን ለመደገፍ ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኗ ትራምፕ መበሳጨታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waltajjii waraanaa gamtaa Ameerikaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa gidduutti godhamu akka gad-xiqqaatu murteessaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame hariiroo gaarii isaan hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Joong Un wajjin qabanirratti hundaa'uudhaan akka ta'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe, mootummaan Kooriyaa Kibbaa dhimma niwukilaaraa Iraan irratti gorsa Ameerikaa fudhachuu diduu isaa hordofee aarii Traamp ka'e boodadha.

title: Norway's king admitted to hospital and put on sick leave
english: Norway's King Harald V has been hospitalized for treatment related to fluid retention and will take a two-week sick leave. During this time, Crown Prince Haakon will assume his royal responsibilities. The 89-year-old monarch has faced several health challenges recently but remains committed to his role without plans to abdicate.
amharic: የኖርዌዩ ንጉሥ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ በሰውነታቸው ውስጥ ፈሳሽ በመከማቸቱ ምክንያት ሆስፒታል የገቡ ሲሆን ለሁለት ሳምንታት ከሥራ እንዲታቀቡ ተወስኗል። በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ አልጋ ወራሹ ልዑል ሃኮን የንጉሣዊ ተግባራትን እንዲያከናውኑ ተመድበዋል። የ89 ዓመቱ ንጉሥ በቅርቡ የተለያዩ የጤና እክሎች ቢገጥሟቸውም፣ ከዙፋናቸው ለመውረድ ምንም ዕቅድ የላቸውም።
oromo: Mootichi biyya Noorway Haaraald 5ffaan dhukkuba dhangala'aan qaama keessatti kuufamuu isaatiin walqabatee hospitaala kan galan yoo ta'u, torban lamaaf boqonnaa fudhataniiru. Yeroo kana keessatti ilmi isaanii hangafni, Luleen Haakon, hojii mootummaa akka gaggeessan ta'eera. Mootichi umriin isaanii 89 kun dhiheenya kana rakkoolee fayyaa garagaraa keessa darbus, aangoo gadhiisuuf karoora tokkollee hin qaban.

title: Vigil held in central London for late Cambridge professor Jason Arday
english: A large crowd gathered at Trafalgar Square in London to mourn the death of Cambridge professor Jason Arday. During the vigil, speakers criticized the media for conducting a harsh campaign against him, linking his passing to issues of racism. Protesters are now demanding a formal public investigation into how he was treated.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩትን የጄሰን አርዳይን ህልፈት ለመዘከር በለንደን ትራፋልጋር አደባባይ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያለው ህዝብ ተሰብስቧል። በስነስርዓቱ ላይ የተናገሩት ሰዎች ሚዲያው በፕሮፌሰሩ ላይ ያደረሰውን አሉታዊ ዘመቻ በማውገዝ የሞታቸው ምክንያት ከዘረኝነት ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በጉዳዩ ላይም አፋጣኝ የሆነ የህዝብ ምርመራ እንዲካሄድ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Namoonni hedduun ta'e magaalaa Landan iddoo Tarafalgaar Iskuweeritti walitti qabamuun du'a piroofeesara Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirij kan ta'an Jeeson Arday kabajanii oolaniiru. Sagantaa kana irratti dubbattoonni, miidiyaaleen piroofeesaricha irratti duula hamaa geggeessaa turuu isaanii fi du'a isaa kana wajjin walqabatee rakkoon sanyi-jibbiinsaa jiraachuu isaanii kaasuun komataniiru. Akkasumas, dhimmicha irratti qorannoon mootummaa akka godhamu gaafataniiru.

title: Zambia’s Hichilema wins second term as president
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema has secured a second term in office after winning approximately 60 percent of the vote. His primary challenger, Brian Mundubile, received 38 percent and has raised concerns regarding potential electoral fraud. The election process faced significant challenges, including reports of violence, ballot theft, and the brief suspension of vote counting.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሀካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ ወደ 60 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምፅ በማግኘት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሀገሪቱ መሪ ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። ዋና ተቀናቃኛቸው ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ 38 በመቶ ድምፅ ያገኙ ሲሆን በምርጫው ሂደት ላይ የማጭበርበር ክስ አቅርበዋል። ምርጫው በግጭት፣ በድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀት ስርቆት እና ለተወሰነ ጊዜ የድምፅ አቆጣጠር መቋረጥ የታጀበ ነበር።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Zaambiyaa Haakayinde Hichiileemaa sagalee harka 60 ol argachuun yeroo lammaffaaf filatamaniru. Dorgomtuun isaanii ijoon Biriyaanii Munduubiilee sagalee harka 38 kan argatan yoo ta'u, filannoo kana keessatti gowwoomsaan raawwatameera jechuun komii kaasuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Adeemsi filannoo kun walitti bu'iinsa, hattaa waraqaa sagalee fi yeroodhaaf sagalee lakkaa'uun dhaabbachuu kan of keessatti qabatedha.

title: Report: Kushner opposes Netanyahu's plans for ongoing targeted killings in Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently informed Jared Kushner that he intends to persist with targeted assassination operations in Gaza. Kushner expressed his disapproval of this strategy during their discussion. Ultimately, the two officials failed to reach a consensus regarding the continuation of these military actions.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ ስትሪፕ የታለሙ ግድያዎችን እንደማያቆሙ ለጃሬድ ኩሽነር ተናግረዋል። ኩሽነር በእነዚህ የጥቃት እርምጃዎች ላይ ተቃውሞውን የገለጸ ሲሆን በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ አልተቻለም።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, gaazaa keessatti duula ajjeechaa lafa irratti xiyyeeffate itti fufuuf akka karoorfatan Jaared Kushneritti himaniiru. Kushneris tooftaa kana mormuufi ilaalcha isaa ibsuun, gama lamaan gidduutti waliigalteen tokkollee akka hin uumamne himameera.

title: Iran war live: Trump rejects MoU extension as US claims control of Hormuz
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the United States will not renew its memorandum of understanding with Iran following the agreement's expiration. Trump has demanded that Iran surrender, while claiming his administration is in talks with the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps. However, the IRGC has explicitly denied that any such discussions are taking place.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን መካከል የነበረው የመግባቢያ ስምምነት ጊዜው ስላለቀበት እንደማያድሱት አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ኢራን እጇን እንድትሰጥ የጠየቁ ሲሆን ከአገሪቱ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ጋር ውይይት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ዘበኛው ግን ይህንን መረጃ አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Donaald Traamp waliigalteen gargaarsaa kan Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu ture xumuramuu isaa hordofee, waliigaltee kana haaromsuuf akka hin barbaanne ibsaniiru. Traamp Iraan akka harka kennattu kan gaafatan yoo ta'u, garee Waraana Wal-abjuu Iraan waliin mari'achaa jiraachuu isaanii himanis, gareen kun garuu mariin akkasii akka hin jirre haaleera.

title: Iran's Araghchi says no justification for 'reckless attack' on Iraq’s Kurdish region
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi condemned a recent attack on the Iraqi Kurdistan prime minister’s office, calling it unjustified and reckless. He urged Kurdish officials to remain alert for hidden attempts to create conflict between the two neighbors. Additionally, Araghchi emphasized Iran's history of supporting the Kurdish people and expressed appreciation for their cooperation in maintaining border security.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቢሮ ላይ የተፈፀመውን ጥቃት አውግዘው፣ ድርጊቱ ምንም አይነት ህጋዊ ምክንያት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። የኩርድ ባለስልጣናት በሁለቱ ጎረቤት አገራት መካከል መለያየትን ለመፍጠር የሚደረጉ ሴራዎችን እንዲጠነቀቁ አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም አራግቺ ኢራን ለኩርድ ህዝብ ያላትን ድጋፍ በማስታወስ፣ በድንበር ደህንነት ላይ ለሚያደርጉት ትብብር ምስጋናቸውን አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iran Abbaas Araagchi haleellaa biiroo muummee ministiraa Kurdistaan Iraaq irratti raawwatame balaaleeffachuun, gochi kun kan hin fudhatamneefi akka tasaa kan raawwatame ta’uu ibsaniiru. Gaggeessitoonni Kurdii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti walitti bu’iinsa uumuuf yaalii dhokataa godhamuuf of eeggannoo akka taasisan gorseera. Kana malees, Araagchi Iran lammiilee Kurdii cinaa dhaabbachuu ishee yaadachiisuun, nageenya daangaa eeguu irratti gumaacha isaan taasisaniif galata galchaniiru.

title: ‘We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt’ until Hamas disarms, Kushner says
english: US envoy Jared Kushner has announced that the reconstruction of the Gaza Strip will not proceed until Hamas surrenders its weapons. Although Hamas had previously agreed to disarm as part of a potential peace process, Israel has rejected these terms, insisting on full demilitarization before any progress occurs. Kushner emphasized that the US will continue to support Israel's right to defend itself against threats, despite recent calls from President Trump to halt ongoing airstrikes.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር የጋዛ ሰርጥ መልሶ ግንባታ የሚከናወነው ሃማስ ትጥቁን ሲፈታ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሃማስ ቀደም ሲል ትጥቅ ለመፍታት ተስማምቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ እስራኤል ማንኛውም አይነት መሻሻል ከመፈጠሩ በፊት ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ መፍታት እንደሚያስፈልግ በመግለጽ ሀሳቡን ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ኩሽነር አሜሪካ እስራኤል ራሷን የመከላከል መብቷን እንደምትደግፍ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአየር ጥቃቶቹ ላይ ማቆም እንዳለባቸው ቢጠይቁም ውጥረቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ergamtuun Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner akka ibsetti, deebisanii ijaaruun daangaa Gaazaa kan danda'amu haalli hammaasuun meeshaa waraanaa hiikate yoo mirkanaa'e qofa dha. Hammaas kanaan dura meeshaa hiikachuuf walii galus, Israa'el haala kanaan dura ture fudhachuu diduun guutummaatti meeshaa irraa bilisa ta'uu akka qaban gaafatteetti. Kushner akka jedhetti, Ameerikaan Israa'el of ittisuuf mirga qabdu akka deeggartu ibseera, kunis Prezidaanti Traampin qilleensa irraa haleellaa dhaabuuf gaaffii dhiyeessan keessattuu itti fufeera.

title: Erdogan says Mecca agreement open to Egypt
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has announced that the recently signed Mecca Agreement between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan is available for other nations to join. He specifically addressed reports regarding Egypt, clarifying that the country is welcome to participate in the pact. This statement serves to dismiss rumors suggesting that Egypt was intentionally excluded from the regional agreement.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመው የመካ ስምምነት ለሌሎች አገራትም ክፍት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በተለይም ግብጽ በዚህ ስምምነት ውስጥ መሳተፍ እንደምትችል በመግለጽ፣ አገሪቷ ከስምምነቱ ውጪ እንደተደረገች የሚናፈሱ ወሬዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ሌሎች የክልሉ አገራትም በስምምነቱ ለመቀላቀል እድል እንዳላቸው አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rejeeb Xayyib Erdogaan waliigalteen Makkaa kan biyyoota Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame, biyyoota biroofis kan baname ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Keessattuu, biyyi Gibxii waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuu akka dandeessu ibsuun, odeeffannoo biyyattiin waliigaltee kana keessaa baate jedhamee tamsa'e dhugaa akka hin taane mirkaneessaniiru. Yaanni kun biyyoonni naannichaa biroo waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuuf carraa akka qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Woman, child injured in Houthi shelling Yemen’s al-Dhale
english: A woman and a child were wounded following a Houthi shelling attack on a residential area in Yemen's Al-Dhale governorate. Local reports indicate that this incident is part of a recent surge in violence by Houthi forces within the Hajar and Murais districts. State media confirmed the attack, highlighting the ongoing threat to civilians in these regions.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በአል-ዳሌ ግዛት በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ባደረሱት የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ አንዲት ሴት እና አንድ ህፃን ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሃጃር እና ሙራይስ ወረዳዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣው የሁቲዎች ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ አካል መሆኑ ተገልጿል። የየመን የመንግስት ዜና ወኪል እንደዘገበው፣ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች ላይ የሚሰነዘረው ጥቃት ስጋት እየጨመረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Godina Al-Dhale kan Yemen keessatti haleellaa boombii gareen Houthi bakka jiraattoonni keessa jiran irratti raawwateen dubartii fi daa’imni tokko miidhamaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsetti, haleellaan kun naannolee Hajar fi Murais keessatti garee Houthiin babal’achaa jiraachuu argisiisa. Miidiyaan mootummaa akka mirkaneessetti, haleellaan kun jireenya namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: As rubble clears, Colombia begins focusing on recovery after the earthquake
english: One week after a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, emergency teams are transitioning from search and rescue operations to long-term recovery and aid distribution. The disaster has resulted in at least 289 deaths, thousands of injuries, and massive damage to housing, schools, and essential infrastructure across 15 provinces. While rescue crews continue their work, the primary focus is now shifting toward providing shelter for the displaced and beginning the reconstruction process.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ አንድ ሳምንት ባስቆጠረበት ወቅት፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ወደ ተጎጂዎች እርዳታ እና መልሶ ግንባታ እየተሸጋገሩ ነው። አደጋው ቢያንስ 289 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን አቁስሎ፣ ቤቶችን፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና መሰረታዊ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አውድሟል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ዋናው ትኩረት ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ በማቅረብ እና የተጎዱ አካባቢዎችን መልሶ ለመገንባት ላይ ተጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa gama dhihaatti sochiin lafaa humna 7.4 qabu erga mudatee torban tokko booda, tattaaffiin fayyisuu gara gargaarsa namoomaa fi ijaarsa bu'uuraa miti-hawaasummaatti ce'aa jira. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 289 yoo darbu, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman miidhamaniiru; akkasumas manni jireenyaa, mana barnootaa fi bu'uuraleen misoomaa bal'inaan barbadaa'aniiru. Yeroo ammaa, xiyyeeffannoon guddaan kanneen qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniif iddoo qubannaa dhiyeessuu fi hojii deebisanii ijaaruu irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha.

title: ‘Truth or fiction’: US trial of Tupac Shakur’s accused killer begins
english: The murder trial of Duane Davis has officially started in Las Vegas, nearly thirty years after the death of legendary rapper Tupac Shakur. Prosecutors argue that Davis acted as the mastermind behind the 1996 drive-by shooting, seeking revenge for a fight involving his nephew. Davis has pleaded not guilty to the murder charges, and the court proceedings are expected to continue for several weeks.
amharic: የታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር ግድያ የጥርጣሬ ተጠርጣሪ የሆነው ዱዌን ዴቪስ የፍርድ ሂደት ከሰላሳ ዓመታት ገደማ በኋላ በላስ ቬጋስ ተጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህግ ዴቪስ በ1996 የራፐሩን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን የሽጉጥ ጥቃት በመምራት የወንድሙን ልጅ በመደብደቡ ለመበቀል እንደተነሳ ይከራከራሉ። ተጠርጣሪው በክሱ ላይ እምቢ ብለዋል፤ የፍርድ ሂደቱ ለሚቀጥሉት በርካታ ሳምንታት እንደሚቆይ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa ragaa du'a rap-artistii beekamaa Tupac Shakur irratti himatamaa Duane Davis jedhamu irratti seeraan banamee jira. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, Duane Davis bara 1996 keessa ajjeechaa Tupac raawwatameef itti gaafatamaa fi qindeessaa akka ture himateera. Himatamaan kun yakka itti dhihaate kan hin fudhanne yoo ta'u, dhaddachi kun torbanoota hedduuf itti fufa jedhamee eegama.

title: Israeli settlers injure two Palestinians, set fire to agricultural lands in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers attacked two Palestinian men in the town of Beita, resulting in injuries that required hospital care. In a separate incident near Ramallah, settlers accompanied by the military burned Palestinian agricultural fields. These events highlight the ongoing violence occurring in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በቤይታ ከተማ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ወጣቶችን በማጥቃታቸው ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል እንዲሄዱ ተደርጓል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ ስር ያሉ ሰፋሪዎች በቱርሙስ አያ ከተማ የፍልስጤማውያንን የግብርና መሬቶች በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚፈጸሙትን ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda Beitaa keessatti dargaggoota Falasxiin lama irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru, kunis namoonni kun gara mana yaalaa akka geeffaman dirqisiiseera. Kana malees, waraana Israa'el gargaaramuun qotee bulaan kunneen lafa qonnaa kan Falasxiinotaa magaala Turmus Ayyaatti gubaniiru. Gochootni kun walitti bu'iinsa fi miidhaa naannoo West Bank keessatti yeroo ammaa mul'atu ibsu.

title: Erdogan urges Trump to continue talks with Iran, offers support
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan recently spoke with Donald Trump to encourage the United States to maintain diplomatic dialogue with Iran and reduce regional tensions. During their conversation, Erdogan expressed his willingness to assist in peace-building initiatives and raised concerns regarding the escalating violence against Palestinians in Gaza. The two leaders also reviewed their bilateral relations and a new defense agreement involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.

oromo: Pireezidaantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Pireezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonald Traamp waliin bilbilan haasa'aniiru. Erdogan, Ameerikaan Iran waliin marii itti fufuun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa akka tasgabbeessitu gaafatanii, carraaqqii nagaa fiduu keessatti gargaarsa gochuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Walta'iinsa kanaan, haleellaa Gaza keessatti Palasteenota irratti raawwatamaa jiru irratti yaaddoo qaban ibsuun, hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fi waliigaltee ittisaa kan Turkii, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame irrattis mari'ataniiru.

title: US envoy backs Yemen government’s fight against Houthis
english: A senior US diplomat in Yemen, Neil Hope, met with Yemeni government officials in Riyadh to affirm his support for their military efforts against Houthi forces. He strongly denounced the Houthi movement's ongoing attacks on civilians. Additionally, Hope praised the government's military leadership for their role in resisting Iranian influence within the country.
amharic: በየመን የዩኤስ ኤምባሲ ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማት ኒል ሆፕ፣ ከየመን መንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር በሪያድ ተገናኝተው በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ለሚያደርጉት ውጊያ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። ዲፕሎማቱ የሁቲ ቡድን በንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ የሚፈጽመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የየመን የመንግስት ሃይሎች ኢራን በየመን በኩል የምታራምደውን ተጽዕኖ ለመመከት ለሚያደርጉት ጥረት አድናቆታቸውን ችረዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan olaanaa iddoo ambaasaaddaraatti argamu kan Yunaayitid Isteets Neil Hoop, qondaaltota mootummaa Yaman waliin Riyaaditti walgayii taasisaniin, lola mootummaan Yaman garee Huutii irratti gaggeessuuf deggarsa qaban mirkaneessaniiru. Gareen Huutii lammilee nagaa irratti haleellaa raawwatu cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Kana malees, qondaaltichi loltoonni mootummaa Yaman dhiibbaa Iiraan biyyattii keessatti uumtu ittisuuf carraaqqii godhan cimsanii galateeffataniiru.

title: Palestinian American reunites with family under siege in West Bank
english: A Palestinian-American man named Loui Ridi recently managed to return to his family home in the West Bank village of Qusra. He arrived to find his relatives living under an intense siege by illegal Israeli settlers. The reunion took place amidst significant intimidation and threats directed at his household.
amharic: ሉዊ ሪዲ የተባሉ አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ በዌስት ባንክ ቂስራ በተባለ መንደር ከሚገኘው ቤተሰባቸው ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ወደ ቤታቸው ሲደርሱ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የተከበቡ መሆናቸውን ተመልክተዋል። ይህ የመገናኘት ሂደት በሰፋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ዛቻ እና ተፅዕኖ ውስጥ ሆኖ የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Namni lammii Ameerikaa fi Falastiin ta'e Loui Ridi jedhamu, gara manaa maatii isaa kan baadiyaa Qusra, West Bank jiruutti deebi'eera. Inni yommuu achi ga'u, maatiin isaa qubattoota Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'aniin marfamanii akka jiran argeera. Wal arguun kunis gidduu sodaa fi dhiibbaa cimaa qubattichoonni isaan irratti raawwatan keessatti ta'e.

title: Civilians paying price as Israeli military raises stakes in Lebanon: UNIFIL
english: The United Nations peacekeeping force in Lebanon reports that civilians are suffering due to a sharp increase in cross-border military strikes over the last two weeks. Despite a June ceasefire agreement, daily projectile fire has intensified, forcing many local families to flee their homes or alter their lives for safety. While Hezbollah opposes the current deal, Lebanese officials are calling for an extension of the UN mission to help stabilize the region.
amharic: በሊባኖስ የሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ በተካሄደው የውጊያ መጠን መጨመር ምክንያት ንፁሃን ዜጎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እየደረሰባቸው መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በሰኔ ወር የተደረገ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ በየቀኑ የሚተኮሱት ሚሳኤሎች ቁጥር መጨመሩ ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን እንዲፈናቀሉ ወይም ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ የዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወታቸውን እንዲቀይሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። ሂዝቦላህ ስምምነቱን ቢቃወምም፣ የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለማረጋጋት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተልዕኮ እንዲቀጥል ጥሪ እያቀረቡ ነው።

Waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa ji'a Waxabajjii godhame iyyuu, guyyaa guyyaatti dhukaasni akka dabaleefi maatiiwwan hedduus manneen isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqamuu ibsameera. Hizaaballaah waligaltee kana kan mormu ta'us, aanga'oonni Libaanoon tasgabbii naannichaa fiduuf ergamni Tokkummaa Mootummootaa akka itti fufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Trump says Iran will not make the deal he believes is necessary
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that Iran is unlikely to reach a nuclear agreement that meets his requirements. He emphasized that the country must be prevented from developing nuclear weapons at all costs. Trump also claimed that previous American military actions have significantly delayed Iran's ability to rebuild its nuclear program.

title: Trump loses second Supreme Court bid over E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has refused to hear Donald Trump's appeal for a second time regarding a 2023 civil case where he was found liable for the sexual abuse and defamation of E. Jean Carroll. This decision confirms the finality of the $5 million jury verdict, which Carroll has already received. While this specific matter is now closed, Trump is still pursuing appeals for a separate defamation judgment involving the same individual.

title: Israeli forces raid Bethlehem rehabilitation hospital
english: Israeli military forces entered the Bethlehem Arab Society for Rehabilitation Hospital on Monday, causing widespread alarm among those inside. Reports indicate that people in the hospital's courtyard were physically attacked during the operation. The Palestinian Ministry of Health has officially denounced the raid, stating that it violates international law and threatens the safety of medical services.

title: Iraq, Iran discuss drone attack on Kurdish PM's office
english: Iraq’s Foreign Minister recently spoke with his Iranian counterpart to address a drone attack targeting the Kurdistan Prime Minister's office in Erbil. While Iraq expressed concern over the impact of this violence on regional security, Iran denied any involvement and claimed to lack information about the origin of the strike. Both countries discussed the situation amid ongoing tensions, with Iran officially condemning the incident as a suspicious development.
amharic: የኢራቅ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በኢርቢል በሚገኘው የኩርዲስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቢሮ ላይ ስለተፈጸመው የድሮን ጥቃት ከኢራን አቻቸው ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። የኢራቅ መንግስት ጥቃቱ ለክልሉ ደህንነት ስጋት መሆኑን ሲገልጽ፣ የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ግን ጥቃቱ ከኢራን መሬት የተፈጸመ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ እንደሌለ በመግለጽ ተሳትፎ እንደሌላቸው አመልክተዋል። ኢራን ጥቃቱን አውግዛ ድርጊቱ አጠራጣሪ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ጉዳዩን በቅርበት እየተከታተለች መሆኗን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraaq miilaa duubatti deebi'ee Erbil keessatti waajjira Ministira Muummee Kurdiistaan irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) gaggeeffame irratti ministira dhimmi alaa Iraan waliin mari'ataniiru. Iraaq haleellaan kun nageenya naannichaa irratti miidhaa akka geessisu ibsuun komii dhiheessite; garuu Iraan haleellaan kun biyya isaanii irraa akka hin banne himuun hirmaannaa akka hin qabne beeksiste. Iraan haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, tarkaanfiin kun shakkiin kan guutame fi qorannoo kan barbaadu ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: UAE, Omani leaders discuss regional, global affairs in Abu Dhabi
english: UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan recently hosted Sultan Haitham bin Tariq of Oman in Abu Dhabi for high-level discussions. The leaders met to address various regional and international developments amid rising geopolitical tensions. This meeting follows recent threats made by US President Donald Trump regarding Oman's ongoing negotiations with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች ፕሬዝዳንት ሞሐመድ ቢን ዛይድ አል ናህያን ከኦማኑ ሱልጣን ሐይሳም ቢን ታሪክ ጋር በአቡ ዳቢ ተገናኝተው ተወያይተዋል። መሪዎቹ ክልላዊ እና አለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮችን በተመለከተ ምክክር ያደረጉት በክልሉ እየተፈጠሩ ባሉ የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረቶች ወቅት ነው። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኦማን ከኢራን ጋር በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳይ እያደረገች ላለው ስምምነት ባሰሙት ማስፈራሪያ መካከል ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Yunaayitid Arab Emireets Mohammad biin Zaa'iid Al Nahyaan, Sultaana Omaan Haayisam biin Taariq waliin magaalaa Abuu Daabii keessatti wal arguun mari'ataniiru. Hogganoonni kunneen dhimmoota naannawaafi addunyaa irratti kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, kunis waldhabdee siyaasaa naannichatti dhalate hordofee kan dhufe dha. Walga'iin kunis, Pireezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, Omaan dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti Iraan waliin walii galtee uummachuu ishee ilaalchisee sodaachisa dhageessisanii booda kan geggeeffame dha.

title: Centcom says it redirected 64 ships amid Hormuz blockade
english: The US Central Command reported that its Navy has successfully diverted 64 commercial ships away from the Strait of Hormuz since the middle of July. During this operation, three vessels were rendered non-operational, and two others were boarded by military forces to enforce compliance. This mission is part of an ongoing effort to maintain a strict security blockade in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ከሐምሌ ወር አጋማሽ ጀምሮ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ባደረገው የባህር ላይ ቁጥጥር 64 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ማስቀየሩን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ሂደት ውስጥ ሦስት መርከቦች እንዳይሰሩ የተደረጉ ሲሆን ሁለት መርከቦች ደግሞ ህግን የማክበር ስራቸውን ለማረጋገጥ በወታደራዊ ሃይሎች ተይዘው ፍተሻ ተካሂዶባቸዋል። ይህ ተግባር በቀጠናው የደህንነት እገዳን ለማስከበር የሚደረግ የዘመቻ አካል ነው።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa US akka ibsetti, gaafa ji'a Adooleessaa irraa eegalee dooniiwwan daldalaa 64 daandii galaana Hormuz irraa gara biraatti akka jijjiiraman taasiseera. Duula kana keessatti dooniiwwan sadii hojii dhaabanii kan turan yoo ta'u, dooniiwwan lameen immoo seera kabachiisuuf jecha waraanaan to'ataman. Tarkaanfiin kun qarqara galaanichaa to'achuuf hojii nageenyaa gaggeeffamaa jiru keessaa isa tokko.

title: 'Political stunt': Cair slams Texas governor for threatening airports that install ablution stations for Muslims
english: The Council on American-Islamic Relations has criticized Texas Governor Greg Abbott for threatening to cut state funding to airports that install washing stations for Muslim prayer. Following this pressure, the Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport canceled its plans for such a facility. The governor claims these stations provide unfair special treatment to one religious group, while critics argue his stance is hypocritical and politically motivated.
amharic: የአሜሪካ-እስልምና ግንኙነት ምክር ቤት የቴክሳስ ገዥ ግሬግ አቦት ለሙስሊሞች የውዱእ ቦታ በሚያዘጋጁ አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ የገንዘብ ድጋፍን እንደሚቆርጡ በማስፈራራታቸው ተችቷቸዋል። በዚህ ጫና ምክንያት የዳላስ-ፎርት ዎርዝ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለእንደዚህ ዓይነቱ አገልግሎት የነበረውን እቅድ ሰርዟል። ገዥው እነዚህ ቦታዎች ለአንድ ሃይማኖት ቡድን ተገቢ ያልሆነ ቅድሚያ ይሰጣሉ ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ፤ ተቺዎች ግን ይህ አቋም ግብዝነት የተሞላበት እና የፖለቲካ ዓላማ ያለው ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Manni maree walitti dhufeenya Musliimota Ameerikaa, garaa garummaa amantii irratti hundaa'uun godambaa bishanii iddoo kadhannaatiif oolu kan ijaaran dirree xiyyaaraa irratti, bulchaan Texas Greg Abbott maallaqa akka kutu yaaluun isaanii mormameera. Dhiibbaa kana hordofee, dirreen xiyyaaraa Dallas-Fort Worth karoora isaa kana dhaabeera. Bulchaan kun iddoowwan kun garee amantii tokkoof guddina addaa kennu jechuun kan falman yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu tarkaanfichi of-tuulummaa fi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabuudha jedhu.

title: Israel can 'finish the job properly' in Gaza if Hamas does not disarm, Kushner says
english: Jared Kushner announced that Hamas has a short window of time to voluntarily disarm and dismantle its tunnels to advance a potential peace plan. He emphasized that if the group fails to take these practical steps, Israel will be fully supported in taking military action to resolve the threat. While Kushner noted that initial discussions were positive, he clarified that Israel maintains its full right to self-defense throughout this process.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር ሃማስ የሰላም ዕቅዱን ለማራመድ ትጥቁን እንዲፈታና በምድር ውስጥ የቆፈራቸውን ዋሻዎች እንዲያፈርስ የጊዜ ገደብ ሰጥቷል። ሃማስ እነዚህን ተግባራዊ እርምጃዎች መውሰድ ካልቻለ፣ እስራኤል ስጋቱን በወታደራዊ መንገድ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማስወገድ የሚያስፈልገውን ድጋፍ እንደምታገኝ አስታውቋል። ኩሽነር ከመጀመሪያዎቹ ውይይቶች ጥሩ ስሜት ቢኖረውም፣ እስራኤል በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ራሷን የመከላከል መብቷ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥቷል።
oromo: Jared Kushner gareen Hamas nagaa buusuuf jecha meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikkatuufi holqa dhokannaa isaa akka diigu yeroo gabaabaa kenneera. Hamas tarkaanfiiwwan kana fudhachuu baannaan, Israa'el soda kana guutummaatti balleessuuf tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf deeggarsa akka argattu dubbateera. Kushner mariin jalqabaa gaarii akka ture kan ibse yoo ta'u, Israa'el haala kam keessattuu of ittisuuf mirga guutuu akka qabdu hubachiiseera.

title: Why did Trump scale back war games with South Korea?
english: Former U.S. President Donald Trump ordered a significant reduction in joint military exercises with South Korea shortly before they were scheduled to begin. He argued that these long-standing drills were provocative and unnecessary given his positive diplomatic relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The decision has sparked questions about whether this gesture aims to foster further peace negotiations and eventually resolve the long-standing conflict between the two nations.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር በመተባበር የሚያደርጉትን የጦር ልምምድ ከመጀመሩ ጥቂት ቀደም ብሎ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ አዘው ነበር። የቆዩት እነዚህ የጋራ ልምምዶች ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ካላቸው መልካም ግንኙነት አንጻር አላስፈላጊ እና ጠበኛ ምልክት የሚሰጡ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ፣ እርምጃው ተጨማሪ የሰላም ንግግሮችን ለማበረታታት እና ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ግጭት ለመፍታት ያለመ ስለመሆኑ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, leenjiin waraanaa Itoophiyaa wajjin walta'uun ta'uuf ture yeroo muraasa dura akka gadi xiqqaatu ajajanii turan. Traamp leenjiiwwan kana kan ilaaleen, hariiroo gaarii isaan geggeessituu biyya sana Kim Jong Un wajjin qabanirratti hundaa'uun, gochi akkasii diinummaa kan agarsiisuu fi barbaachisaa miti jedhaniiru. Murteen kun, tarkaanfiin kun marii nagaa dabalataa jajjabeessuufi walitti bu'iinsa dheeraa ture kana furuuf kan kaayyeffate ta'uu isaa irratti gaaffilee garaagaraa uumeera.

title: Gaza flotilla sets sail from the UK in bid to break Israeli siege
english: A group of 12 volunteers has departed from Bristol, England, on a boat intended to deliver humanitarian aid to Gaza. This mission is part of an ongoing effort to challenge the Israeli blockade of the territory. Previous attempts to break the siege have faced forceful intervention by Israeli authorities, resulting in reports of mistreatment of the participants.
amharic: አስራ ሁለት በጎ ፈቃደኞችን የያዘ ጀልባ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለጋዛ ለማድረስ ከብሪስቶል እንግሊዝ ተነስቷል። ይህ ጉዞ በእስራኤል የተጣለውን የጋዛ እገዳ ለመስበር እየተደረገ ካለው ጥረት አንዱ አካል ነው። ቀደም ሲል እገዳውን ለመስበር የተደረጉ ሙከራዎች በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በኃይል መገታታቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Humni namoota fedhii qaban kudha-lamaa ta'an, gargaarsa namoomaa gara Gaazaatti geessuuf bidiruu qabatanii magaalaa Bristol, Ingilizii irraa ka'aniiru. Imalli kun mootummaan Israa'el deeggarsaafi meeshaalee gara Gaazaatti galan irratti kutee jiru san cabsanii galuuf yaalii godhamu dha. Kanaan dura yaaliin akkanaa Israa'el irraa dhiibbaa fi haleellaan akka isaan mudatu beekamaa dha.

title: Photos: Search for Indonesia earthquake victims continues
english: A powerful earthquake in eastern Indonesia has claimed at least 68 lives and left over 200 people injured. Rescue efforts and aid delivery are being severely restricted by persistent aftershocks and dangerous landslides that have blocked local roads. Thousands of survivors remain displaced, living in tents while fearing further structural collapses following the destruction of hundreds of homes.
amharic: በምስራቅ ኢንዶኔዢያ በተከሰተ ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ሲያጡ ከ200 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ተከታታይ የምድር ንዝረቶች እና በተከሰቱ የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋዎች መንገዶች በመዘጋታቸው የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች እና የዕርዳታ አቅርቦት ከፍተኛ ችግር ገጥሟቸዋል። በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመፍረሳቸው ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች መኖሪያቸውን ለቀው በድንኳን ውስጥ ለመጠለል ተገደዋል።
oromo: Baha Indoneezhiyaatti sochiin lafaa cimaan erga mudatee booda namoonni 68 lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, namoonni 200 ol ta'an immoo miidhamaniiru. sochii lafaa itti aanuufi lafti sigigaachuun karaa cufuun isaa hojii gargaarsaafi namoota gargaaruu irratti gufuu guddaa ta'ee jira. manneen dhibbaan lakkaa'aman barbadaa'uu isaatiin walqabatee, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii dunkaana keessa jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Kushner says Iran, US conversations are robust but no understanding reached yet
english: Jared Kushner stated that communication between the United States and Iran is currently very active. However, he noted that the two nations have not yet managed to form any formal agreements or mutual understandings. This update follows recent denials from Iran's military leadership regarding the existence of secret negotiations with American officials.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት አማካሪ እና አማች ጃሬድ ኩሽነር፣ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው የሐሳብ ልውውጥ ከወትሮው በበለጠ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ እንደሚገኝ ተናግረዋል። ሆኖም ሁለቱ ወገኖች እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ስምምነት ላይ አለመድረሳቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ኃይል ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር በድብቅ እየተደራደሩ መሆናቸውን በይፋ ከካዱ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Gorsaan fi ilma-guddatan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner, mariin Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa jiru baay'ee cimaa fi amansiisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, gariin kunneen hanga ammaatti waliigaltee kamiyyuu irra gahuu akka hin dandeenye himaniiru. Ibsi kun kan dhufe, humni waraana Iraan marii dhokataa Ameerikaa wajjin godhachaa jiraachuu isaanii erga haalanii boodadha.

title: Unifil records ‘marked increase’ in Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon
english: The United Nations peacekeeping mission in southern Lebanon reported a significant rise in Israeli military operations over the last two weeks. Statistics show hundreds of projectiles were launched daily, causing widespread instability in the region. Local families are suffering greatly, with many forced to flee their homes or drastically alter their lives due to the constant danger.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመሩን አስታውቋል። በየቀኑ በሚተኮሱ በርካታ ሚሳኤሎች ምክንያት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ አለመረጋጋት ተፈጥሯል። ይህ ሁኔታ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎችን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ በማድረግና የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሯቸውን በማወክ ከፍተኛ ስቃይ እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ergamoon nageenya eegumsaa kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kibba Libaanoos jiru, torban lamaan darban keessa hojiin waraanaa Israa'el iddoo sana akka dabale beeksiseera. Guyyaa guyyaan meeshaaleen waraanaa hedduun dhukaafamuun isaanii naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuun akka uumamu godheera. Haalli kun maatiin hedduu manaa isaanii akka godaanan fi jireenyi guyyaa guyyaa isaanii akka rakkoo keessa galu taasiseera.

title: Trump approval hits new second-term low
english: A recent Reuters/Ipsos poll shows that President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to a new second-term low of 33 percent. Most Americans now express dissatisfaction with his leadership, with disapproval reaching 64 percent. Additionally, the vast majority of the public anticipates a long-term military presence in Iran following the collapse of the recent ceasefire.
amharic: አዲሱ የሮይተርስ/ኢፕሶስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሥራ አፈጻጸም ተቀባይነት ወደ 33 በመቶ ዝቅ በማለት በሁለተኛው የስልጣን ዘመናቸው ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን በፕሬዚዳንቱ አሰራር ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በመግለጽ፣ የውድቅ ድምፅ መጠኑ 64 በመቶ ደርሷል። ከዚህም በላይ፣ የቅርብ ጊዜው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ካለቀ በኋላ አሜሪካ በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ ረጅም ጊዜ በኢራን ጉዳይ ውስጥ እንደምትቆይ አብዛኛው ህዝብ ይጠብቃል።
oromo: Qorannoon Reuters/Ipsos haaraan akka ibsutti, fudhatamummaan prezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp sadarkaa 33%tti gadi bu'uun yeroo isaanii isa lammaffaa keessatti sadarkaa gadaanaa haaraa galmeesseera. Ameerikaanonni hedduun hojii prezidantichaa irratti komii qaban kan ibsan yoo ta'u, mormitoonni isaanii 64% ga'aniiru. Kana malees, waldhabdeen waraanaa erga dhaabatee ture erga dhumee booda, ummanni hedduun Ameerikaan dhimma Iraan keessatti yeroo dheeraaf akka turu yaadu.

title: Death toll from capsized ferry in Zimbabwe rises to 92
english: The death toll from a ferry disaster on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has reached 92 after search teams recovered additional bodies. The vessel, which was reportedly overloaded, capsized last week due to strong winds while traveling to remote communities. Emergency crews continue to search the lake as authorities investigate the tragedy, which is considered the deadliest incident of its kind in the country.
amharic: በዚምባብዌ ካሪባ ሐይቅ ላይ የደረሰው የጀልባ አደጋ የተጎጂዎችን ቁጥር ወደ 92 ከፍ አድርጎታል። በአቅም በላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን ጭና የነበረችው ጀልባው በከባድ ነፋስ ምክንያት ሰጥማለች። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች የጠፉ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ አሁንም የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ የከፋው ይህ አደጋ እንዲጣራ አዟል።
oromo: Zimbaabwee keessatti markabni haroo Kaaribaa keessatti gombifame lubbuu namoota 92 galaafateera. Markabichi namoota baay'ee fe'ee imala isaa irra osoo jiru, qilleensa cimaan gombifame. Yeroo ammaa kana gareen fayyadamtootaa qaama namaa barbaaduu itti fufanii jiru, mootummaanis balaa kana qorachuuf hojjechaa jira.

title: Russian politician sentenced to 11 years for opposing war in Ukraine
english: A prominent Russian opposition politician, Lev Shlosberg, has been sentenced to over eleven years in prison. He was found guilty of spreading allegedly false information and discrediting the country's military due to his public criticism of the war in Ukraine. This legal action occurs just ahead of the nation's upcoming parliamentary elections.
amharic: የሩሲያ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ ከፍተኛ አመራር የሆኑት ሌቭ ሽሎስበርግ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ላይ ባደረጉት ተቃውሞ ከ11 ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈረደባቸው። ግለሰቡ በሩሲያ ወታደሮች ላይ የተሳሳተ መረጃ በማሰራጨት እና ስም በማጥፋት ተከሰው ነው ይህ ብይን የተላለፈባቸው። ይህ የእስር ውሳኔ የተሰጠው በአገሪቱ ሊካሄድ በተቃረበው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ወቅት መሆኑ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mormituu biyya Rashiyaa kan ta'an Lev Shlosberg, waraana Yukreen irratti mormii kaasaniin hidha waggaa 11 fi baatii tokkoo itti murameera. Gochaan kun kan raawwatame bulchiinsa biyyattii irratti odeeffannoo sobaa facaasanii fi waraana xiqqeessaniiru jedhamanii erga himatamanii booda. Murtiin kun kan darbe, filannoon paarlaamaa biyyattii dhihaachaa jiruttiidha.

title: Russia maintains election ban on opposition Yabloko, jails deputy head
english: The Russian Supreme Court has blocked the anti-war Yabloko party from participating in the upcoming parliamentary elections after dismissing their appeal. On the same day, the party's deputy leader, Lev Shlosberg, was sentenced to over 11 years in prison for criticizing the military's actions in Ukraine. Critics view these legal actions as a deliberate effort by the government to suppress political opposition and stifle dissent regarding the war.
amharic: የሩሲያ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ጦርነትን የሚቃወመው ያብሎኮ ፓርቲ በመጪው የፓርላማ ምርጫ እንዳይሳተፍ የወሰነውን ውሳኔ አጽንቷል። በዚሁ ቀን የፓርቲው ምክትል መሪ ሌቭ ሽሎስበርግ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ላይ ባላቸው ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ከአስራ አንድ ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እነዚህ እርምጃዎች መንግስት ተቃዋሚዎችን ለማፈን እና በጦርነቱ ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን ትችት ለመዝጋት የሚጠቀምባቸው ስልቶች እንደሆኑ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Raashiyaa paartiin Yabloko jedhamu kan waraana mormu, filannoo dhufu irratti akka hinhirmaanne murteessuu isaatiin booda komii isaanii fudhachuu dide. Guyyaa sana keessa, hoogganaan paartichaa itti aanaan Lev Shlosberg, waraana Yukreen irratti yaada mormii isaa ibsachuu isaatiin hidha waggaa 11 fi baatii tokkoo itti murtaa'e. Namoonni biyyoolessaa fi gareewwan mirga namoomaa murtoowwan kun mootummaan mormitoota ukkaamsuufi yaada waraana irratti jiru callisiisuuf kan fudhataman akka ta'e himu.

title: Iran condemns 'suspicious' attack on Iraqi Kurdistan PM's office
english: Iran's Foreign Ministry has officially denounced a recent drone strike aimed at the office of the Prime Minister in Iraqi Kurdistan. Spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei labeled the incident as a highly questionable event that demands immediate caution and thorough investigation. Iranian authorities are emphasizing the need for heightened alertness following this security breach.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽሕፈት ቤት ላይ የተፈጸመውን የድሮን ጥቃት በይፋ አውግዟል። የኢራን ቃል አቀባይ እስማኤል ባቃኢ ጥቃቱን አጠራጣሪ ክስተት ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ ጥንቃቄ እና ጥልቅ ምርመራ እንደሚያስፈልገው አስገንዝበዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህን የጸጥታ ጥሰት ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል።

Dubbi himaan ministeerichaa Ismaa'eel Baqaa'ii, haleellaan kun waan shakkiin keessa jiruuf xiyyeeffannoo fi qorannoo cimaa akka barbaadu ibsaniiru. Aangeyyoonni Iraan nageenya irratti miidhaan akkasii waan uumameef, dammaqinaan akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru.

title: Trump says US not seeking to extend interim deal with Iran
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States does not intend to renew its interim agreement with Iran. He expressed doubt that Iran would agree to the specific terms he considers necessary for a formal deal. Consequently, the temporary memorandum of understanding has been allowed to expire without further extension.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር የነበራትን ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት ለማራዘም እቅድ እንደሌላት አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን ለአዲስ ስምምነት የሚያስፈልጉትን ሁኔታዎች እንደማታሟላ እምነት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። በዚህም መሰረት ቀደም ሲል የነበረው ጊዜያዊ የመግባቢያ ሰነድ ጊዜው ካለቀ በኋላ እንዲቋረጥ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Yunaayitid Isteets waliigaltee yeroo gabaabaa Iraan wajjin qabdu haaromsuuf fedhii hin qabdu. Iraan haala inni barbaaduun waliigaltee irra gahuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, waliigaltee yeroo darbe ture sun yeroonsaa erga guutee booda akka hin haaromsamne murteeffameera.

title: UAE issues rare denial of 'imperial ambitions' in Africa
english: The United Arab Emirates has officially rejected allegations that it is pursuing imperialist goals across Africa. Emirati officials criticized recent media reports as patronizing, arguing that their African partnerships are based on mutual national interests rather than foreign domination. This denial follows various investigations, including those by the Financial Times, which linked the UAE to military support for the Rapid Support Forces in Sudan's ongoing conflict and the illicit trade of gold.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች በአፍሪካ አህጉር ኢምፔሪያሊስት የመስፋፋት ፍላጎት አላት የሚለውን ክስ በይፋ አስተባብላለች። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት በአፍሪካ አጋሮች ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት በጋራ ጥቅም ላይ የተመሰረተ እንጂ የውጭ የበላይነትን ለመጫን አይደለም ሲሉ ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውድቅ የተደረገው የፋይናንሻል ታይምስን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የመገናኛ ብዙሃን የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች በሱዳን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ውስጥ ለራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሰስ (RSF) ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እያደረገች እንደሆነና በወርቅ ንግድ ውስጥም እጅ እንዳለባት የሚያሳዩ ዘገባዎችን ካወጡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Emirates Arraboota Gamtoomanii (UAE) biyyoota Afrikaa keessatti fedhii weerartummaa ykn impaayerummaa qabda jedhamee himatame kana akkaataa seeraatti haalteetti. Aangoo cimaan mootummaa UAE ibsa baaseen, hidhata isaan biyyoota Afrikaa wajjin qaban faayidaa biyyaalessaa waloo irratti kan hundaa'e malee, dhiibbaa alagaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate miti jedheera. Haalni kun kan dhufe, gabaasni 'Financial Times' fi miidiyaaleen biroo UAE waraana siviilii Sudaan keessatti garee Raapiid Saport Foorsis (RSF) deggaruu fi gurgurtaa warqee seeraan alaa keessatti hirmaachuu ishee ibsuun isaanii booda dha.

title: Turkey, Iran discuss efforts to reopen Strait of Hormuz, continue US-Iran ceasefire
english: Turkish and Iranian foreign ministers recently spoke by phone to address regional security concerns. They focused on keeping the Strait of Hormuz accessible and maintaining the ongoing ceasefire between Iran and the United States. This diplomatic discussion follows reports of stalled peace negotiations and rising military tensions.
amharic: የቱርክ እና የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በክልሉ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። ንግግራቸው የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤን ክፍት ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል እና በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለማስቀጠል ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው የሰላም ድርድር መቆሙን ተከትሎ ውጥረት በተፈጠረበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Turkey fi Iran rakkoolee nageenyaa naannichaa irratti mari’ataniiru. Mariin isaanii karaa galaana Hormuz banamee akka itti fufuufi walii galtee dhaabbii waraana gidduu Iran fi Ameerikaa jidduu jiru akka eegamuuf kan xiyyeeffate ture. Mariin kun kan ta’e yeroo mariin nagaa biyyoota lamaanii addaan citee fi walitti bu’iinsi dabalaa jiru kanatti.

title: French PM heckled over wildfire response as blazes continue across Europe
english: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu faced angry protests from residents during his visit to areas in France heavily damaged by recent wildfires. While locals demanded accountability and transparency regarding the firefighting strategy, the government pledged 12 million euros in financial aid and promised to fast-track the rebuilding of destroyed homes. Meanwhile, other parts of Europe, including Belgium and Spain, are also struggling to contain ongoing forest fires.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሴባስቲያን ሌኮርኑ በጫካ እሳት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ጉብኝት ሲያደርጉ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከል ስራው አጠያያቂ እንደነበር በመግለጽ ማብራሪያ ሲጠይቁ፣ መንግስትም ለተጎጂዎች የ12 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ ድጋፍ እንደሚሰጥና የተቃጠሉ ቤቶችን መልሶ ለመገንባት እንደሚያፋጥን ቃል ገብቷል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ በቤልጂየምና በስፔን ጨምሮ በሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራትም የጫካ እሳት አደጋዎች አሁንም ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Faransaay Sebaastiyaan Leekornuu naannolee ibidda bosonaatiin midhaan gahan daawwatanitti uummata aare irraa mormii quunnameera. Jiraattonni haala ittisa ibiddaa irratti ibsaafi itti gaafatamummaa gaafatanis, mootummaan gargaarsa Euroo miiliyoona 12 qopheessuufi manneen barbadaa'an hatattamaan akka ijaaramu waadaa galeera. Gama biraatiin, biyyoota Awurooppaa kanneen akka Beljiyeemifi Ispeen keessatti ibidda bosonaa to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaan taasifamaa jira.

title: Mushroom murderer Erin Patterson is appealing - here's what you need to know
english: Erin Patterson, who was sentenced to life imprisonment for poisoning three family members with toxic mushrooms, is challenging her conviction. She claims her trial was unfair due to issues with evidence and jury conduct, while prosecutors are simultaneously seeking a harsher sentence, arguing her parole eligibility is too lenient. The 2023 incident resulted in the deaths of her in-laws and a family friend, while her estranged husband has previously alleged that she attempted to poison him multiple times in the past.
amharic: መርዛማ እንጉዳይ በመጠቀም ሶስት የቤተሰብ አባላትን በመግደል የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት የተፈረደባት ኤሪን ፓተርሰን፣ ፍርዱን በመቃወም ይግባኝ ጠይቃለች። ፓተርሰን የፍርድ ሂደቱ ፍትሃዊ እንዳልነበር እና በምስክርነት እና በጁሪ አባላት አሰራር ላይ ችግሮች እንደነበሩ ትከራከራለች። በሌላ በኩል፣ አቃቤ ህግ የቅጣቱ መጠን አነስተኛ ነው በማለት ይበልጥ ተጠናክሮ እንዲቀጣ ይግባኝ አቅርቧል። በ2023 በተፈጠረው አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተጎጂዋ የቀድሞ ባል ከዚህ ቀደም በተደጋጋሚ መርዛማ ምግብ ለመስጠት እንደሞከረች ከሰሷት በኋላ፣ ጥንዶቹ ተለያይተው እንደነበር ታውቋል።
oromo: Erin Paatarsan jedhamtu, miseensota maatii ishee sadii xaxee summii kenne ajjeeste jechuun hidhaa guutummaa jireenyaa itti murame, murtee kana mormuudhaan gadi baasuuf iyyata dhiheeffatteetti. Inniis adeemsa seeraa keessatti ragaalee fi murtii juriirra dogoggorri akka ture waan amantuuf, haqni akka hin argamne ibsiti. Gama biraatiin, abbaan alangaa yeroo murtaa'eef hidhamtee booda gad dhiifamuu dandeessi jedhamee murteeffame mormuun, adabbiin ishee cimaa ta'uu akka qabu falmataa jira. Balaa bara 2023 gahe kanaan ajjeechaan raawwatame kun, abbaan manaa ishee duraanii yeroo baay'ee summii itti kennuuf yaaltee akka ture himachuu isaa waliin wal qabatee hedduu nama rifachiiseera.

title: CAIR slams Texas governor’s ‘anti-Muslim stunt’ on airport washing stations
english: The Council on American–Islamic Relations has criticized Texas Governor Greg Abbott for forcing the Dallas-Fort Worth airport to cancel plans for Islamic foot-washing stations. Governor Abbott argued that these facilities constitute illegal religious favoritism and threatened to withdraw state funding if they were built. However, civil rights advocates maintain that such accommodations are lawful and have labeled the governor's actions as a politically motivated attack on Muslims.
amharic: የአሜሪካ-እስልምና ግንኙነት ምክር ቤት (CAIR) የቴክሳስ ገዢ ግሬግ አቦት በዳላስ-ፎርት ዎርዝ አየር ማረፊያ ሊገነቡ የነበሩ የእስልምና የእግር ማጠቢያ ስፍራዎችን እንዲሰረዙ በማድረጋቸው ተቃውሞ አሰምቷል። ገዢው አቦት እነዚህ ቦታዎች ህገ-ወጥ የሃይማኖት አድልዎ እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ፣ ካልተሰረዙ የበጀት ድጋፍ እንደሚቆርጡ በማስፈራራት አየር ማረፊያው እቅዱን እንዲተው አድርገዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ይህ ውሳኔ የሙስሊሞችን መብት የሚጋፋ እና ለፖለቲካዊ ጥቅም ሲባል የተደረገ አድልዎ ነው በማለት ኮንነውታል።
oromo: Manni Maree Hariiroo Ameerikaa fi Islaamummaa (CAIR) gaazexessaa mooticha Teeksaas Greg Abbott buufata xiyyaaraa Daallas-Foorti Wortiirratti bakka qaama dhiqannaa (wudu) islaamotaa akka dhaabamu sagantaa ture akka haqamu waan taasiseef mormii dhageessiseera. Bulchaan Abbott bakkeewwan kun amantii tokkoof gargarummaa waan uumaniif seeraan alaa dha jedhanii, yoo hojiirra oolan deeggarsa maallaqaa mootummaa akka dhaaban doorsisaniiru. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa garuu, murtii kana akka yaada siyaasaa fi miidhaa muslimoota irratti xiyyeeffateetti waan fudhataniif jabinaan balaaleffataniiru.

title: Clashes between government and opposition fighters in Somalia’s Baidoa
english: Violent fighting has erupted in the city of Baidoa, Somalia, involving both federal government forces and armed opposition factions. The confrontation led to several civilian casualties during the unrest. Tensions remain high in the area as a result of these ongoing hostilities.
amharic: በሶማሊያ ባይዶአ ከተማ በፌዴራል መንግስት ወታደሮች እና በተቃዋሚ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች መካከል ከፍተኛ ግጭት ተቀስቅሷል። በዚህ ግጭት የተነሳ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት በአካባቢው ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Magaalaa Baidoa kan Somalee keessatti waraanni mootummaa fi gareen mormituu walitti bu'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan namootni nagaa hedduun miidhamaniiru. Rakkoon kun ammayyuu itti fufee waan jiruuf naannichatti muddamni cimaan jira.

title: Syria launches probe into death of ‘White Helmet’ rescuer in police custody
english: Syrian authorities have opened an investigation following the death of Mohammed Gamira, a former White Helmet volunteer who died in police custody in Latakia. His family claims that officers ignored his medical history of hemophilia and subjected him to brutal beatings, leading to fatal internal injuries. The incident has sparked public outrage and protests across the country, as citizens demand accountability for the mistreatment of prisoners.
amharic: በላታኪያ ፖሊስ ጣቢያ ታስሮ የነበረው የቀድሞ የነጭ ኮፍያ (White Helmet) በጎ ፈቃደኛ መሐመድ ጋሚራ መሞቱን ተከትሎ የሶሪያ ባለሥልጣናት ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሟች ቤተሰቦች እንደሚሉት፣ ፖሊስ ለጋሚራ የደም መርጋት ህመም (hemophilia) ትኩረት ሳይሰጥ ከፍተኛ ድብደባ በመፈጸሙ ለህልፈት ዳርጎታል። ይህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰ ሲሆን፣ በብዙ የሶሪያ ክፍሎች የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች እንዲካሄዱ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan Suuriyaa qorannoo eegale jira erga Mohammed Gamira namni duraanii miseensa garee 'White Helmet' ture to'annoo poolisii keessatti du'ee booda. Maatiin isaa akka jedhanitti, poolisoonni dhukkuba isa (hemophilia) akka hin taane beekanii osoo jiranu gara jabinaan rukutanii miidhaa keessoo erga irra ga'ee booda du'e. Gochi kun uummata Suuriyaa hedduu aarseera; kanaafis biyyattii keessatti mormiin guddaan akka ka'u ta'eera.

title: Oman intensifies efforts to contain oil spill from stranded ship
english: Oman is working hard to manage a massive oil spill spreading over 2,000 square kilometers near al-Qibliyyah Island. The vessel involved, the Caroline Bezengi, suffered a suspected explosion earlier this month and is currently stranded. Response teams are facing significant difficulties because the ship is unstable and lacks the power needed to operate necessary cleanup equipment.
amharic: ኦማን በአል-ቂብሊያ ደሴት አቅራቢያ ከ2,000 ካሬ ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ በተስፋፋው የነዳጅ መፍሰስ አደጋ ላይ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ ጥረት እያደረገች ነው። የካሮላይን ቤዘንጊ የተባለው መርከብ ሰኔ 8 ቀን በደረሰ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት ከተጎዳ በኋላ በአካባቢው ተጣብቋል። የመርከቧ የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መቋረጥ እና የመርከቧ ደህንነት የተጠበቀ አለመሆን ለጽዳት ስራው ትልቅ ተግዳሮት ሆኗል።
oromo: Omaan bishaan galaanaafi naannoo al-Qibliyyahitti dhangala'iinsa boba'aa bal'ina kiilomeetira iskuweerii 2,000 ol ta'u to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jirti. Markabni 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kun ji'a kana keessa qophii kanaan dura mudateen booda galaanatti caccabee dhaabbate. Hojjattoonni fayyisuuf hojjetan, markabichi humna ibsaa waan hin qabneefi haalli markabichaa nageenya kan hin qabneef hojiin kun rakkoo cimaa keessa jira.

title: Explosion reported at school in Afghan capital Kabul
english: An explosion occurred at a school in the Dasht-e-Barchi neighborhood of Kabul, Afghanistan, injuring several students. While the exact cause and casualty count remain unconfirmed, some reports suggest a hand grenade may have been used. The Taliban government has not yet provided an official statement regarding the incident.
amharic: በአፍጋኒስታን ዋና ከተማ ካቡል ዳሽት-ኢ-ባርቺ በተባለ ሰፈር በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ በተፈጠረ ፍንዳታ በርካታ ተማሪዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የፍንዳታው ትክክለኛ ምክንያት እና የሟቾች ወይም የጉዳት መጠኑ እስካሁን በይፋ አልታወቀም፤ አንዳንዶች ግን ፍንዳታው በእጅ ቦምብ የደረሰ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይጠቁማሉ። የታሊባን መንግስት እስካሁን ድረስ ስለሁኔታው የሰጠው አስተያየት የለም።
oromo: Magaalaa Kaabul, naannoo Dasht-e-Barchi jedhamutti mana barumsaa tokkotti dhukaatiin uumameen barattoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Sababa dhukaatichaa fi lakkoofsi namoota miidhamanii sirritti kan hin mirkanneeffamne ta'us, gabaasawwan tokko tokko dhukaatiin kun boombii harkaatiin kan uumame ta'uu malu jedhu. Mootummaan Taalibaan hanga ammaatti waa'ee dhimmichaa ibsa tokkollee hin kennine.

title: Britain deploys military as wildfires spread across Europe
english: Severe wildfires are currently spreading across multiple European countries, including Greece, Spain, and Italy, leading to mass evacuations and significant property damage. In response to the growing crisis, the British government has sent military forces to assist with firefighting efforts in Wales. Thousands of residents near the Belgian border have also been forced to leave their homes as emergency services struggle to contain the flames.
amharic: በአውሮፓ የተለያዩ ሀገራት የተከሰቱት የሰደድ እሳት ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል። ችግሩን ለመቆጣጠር ብሪታኒያ ወታደሮቿን ወደ ዌልስ የላከች ሲሆን በቤልጂየም ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ ሰዎችም አካባቢያቸውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። ግሪክን፣ ስፔንን እና ጣሊያንን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ሀገራት የተነሳው እሳት የሰዎችን መኖሪያ ቤት እያወደመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Awurooppaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa babal'achaa jiruun biyyoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Rakkoo kana to'achuuf mootummaan Britaniyaa waraana ishee gara Welisitti eriteetti. Biyyoota akka Girees, Ispeen fi Xaaliyaanii keessatti ibidda ka'een qe'ee fi qabeenyi hedduun barbadaa'uu irra darbee, namoonni kumaatama heddumminaan iddoo jireenyaa isaanii gadhiisuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Netanyahu’s Likud Party holds primaries ahead of Israel’s general elections
english: Israel's Likud Party is conducting primary elections to finalize its candidate list for the upcoming national vote. These internal elections are particularly significant as the party faces a pivotal moment in its political history under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The process will determine the ranking of candidates, which directly influences how many representatives the party will secure in the next Knesset.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ሊኩድ ፓርቲ ለሚመጣው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ የሚወዳደሩትን እጩዎች ለመምረጥ የውስጥ ምርጫ እያካሄደ ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ለፓርቲው ወሳኝ በሆነ ወቅት ላይ ስለሚገኙ ይህ ሂደት ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አግኝቷል። የምርጫው ውጤት የፓርቲውን የእጩዎች ዝርዝር ደረጃ የሚወስን ሲሆን ይህም በፓርላማ ውስጥ የሚያገኙትን መቀመጫዎች ቁጥር የሚወስን ይሆናል።
oromo: Paartiin Likud kan Israa'el filannoo biyyoolessaa dhufuuf qophii isaa xumuruuf filannoo keessoo geggeessaa jira. Filannoon kun yeroo murtii guddaa ta'e kana keessatti muummicha ministeeraa Beniyaamiin Netiyaahuu fi paartichaaf baay'ee murteessaa dha. Adeemsi kun tarree maqaa dorgomtootaa kan murteessu yoo ta'u, kunis boordii paarlaamaa keessatti bakka meeqa akka argatan kan murteessu dha.

title: Palestinians, Israelis sceptical of Gaza plan as Kushner visits region
english: US envoy Jared Kushner has traveled to the region to promote a new peace roadmap for Gaza. Despite his meetings with Israeli and Hamas leadership, both sides remain doubtful about the proposal's success. Furthermore, the plan has already faced opposition from within the Israeli government, leaving little optimism for a breakthrough.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር ለጋዛ አዲስ የሰላም ዕቅድ ይዘው ወደ አካባቢው ተጉዘዋል። ምንም እንኳን ከእስራኤል እና ከሃማስ መሪዎች ጋር ቢወያዩም፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ዕቅዱ ስኬታማ እንደሚሆን ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። በተጨማሪም፣ ይህ የመፍትሄ ሃሳብ በእስራኤል በኩል ቀድሞውኑ ውድቅ በመደረጉ፣ ስምምነት ላይ የመድረስ ተስፋው ዝቅተኛ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ergamaan Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa haarawa Gaazaaf qopheesse fudhatee gara naannichaa imaleera. Hogganoota Israa'elii fi Hamaas waliin kan mari'atan ta'us, gareen lamaanuu karoora kana milkaa'a jedhanii hin amanan. Kana malees, karoorichi mootummaa Israa'el biratti dursee waan mormameef, walii galtee irra ga'uun ulfaataa ta'uun ibsameera.

title: British PM Burnham duped by White House impostor
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham was tricked into exchanging messages with an individual pretending to be the White House Chief of Staff. After realizing the deception, he ended the conversation and reported the incident to the appropriate authorities. This event highlights growing security concerns regarding the misuse of artificial intelligence by malicious actors to impersonate high-level government officials.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዋይት ሃውስ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን ነኝ በሚል ግለሰብ ተታለለው መልእክት ሲለዋወጡ ነበር። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ አጭበርባሪ መሆኑን ሲረዱ ግንኙነቱን ያቋረጡ ሲሆን ለሚመለከታቸው አካላትም ሪፖርት አድርገዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት አማካኝነት ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናትን በመምሰል የሚፈጸም የሳይበር ጥቃት ስጋት እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Biritaaniyaa Andy Burnham nama ofiin 'Chief of Staff' waajjira White House dha jedhee sobee itti dhufe waliin ergaa wal-jijjiiree ture. Erga shakkii itti uumamee booda qunnamticha addaan kutee qaama dhimmi ilaaluuf gabaaseera. Taateen kun namoota hamoo ta'an fayyadama teeknoolojii AI hiri'isanii itti fayyadamuun aanga'oota biyyaa fakkaachuun gowwoomsuun akka dabalaa jiru mul'isa.

title: Israeli forces raid town, bulldoze Palestinian land west of Ramallah
english: Israeli military forces entered the town of Deir Ammar near Ramallah on Monday to clear Palestinian land for a new road, sparking fears of further settlement expansion. During the operation, settlers entered an unfinished home in the area and displayed an Israeli flag. Additionally, security tensions increased as troops raided another nearby village while settlers carried out attacks on the outskirts of a different town in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰኞ ዕለት ወደ ራማላህ አቅራቢያ የምትገኘው ዲር አማር ከተማ በመግባት ለአዲስ መንገድ ግንባታ የፍልስጤማውያንን መሬት አፍርሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው የሰፈራ መስፋፋትን ያስከትላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። በዚሁ ወቅት እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በግንባታ ላይ ያለ ቤት በመውረር የራሳቸውን ሰንደቅ ዓላማ ሰቅለዋል፤ በተጨማሪም በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ ሌሎች ከተሞች ላይ ወታደራዊ ወረራዎች እና ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa’el Wiixata darbe magaalaa Ramallaah bira jirtu Deir Ammaar seenuun, karaa haaraa ijaaruuf lafa warra Falasxiin mancaasaniiru. Gochi kun babal'ina buufataalee naannichaa wajjin walqabachuu danda'a soda jedhu uumeera. Yeroo kanatti, qe’ee buqqaatonni mana ijaaramaa jiru tokko seenuun alaabaa Israa'el dhaabuun isaanii gabaafameera; kanaan alattiis naannichatti waraanaafi haleellaan biroo magaalota biraa irratti raawwatameera.

title: Fire breaks out in town near Jerusalem, following Israeli military raid
english: A fire started in the town of Beit Anan, near Jerusalem, on Monday evening following an Israeli military operation. Local reports indicate that the blaze was triggered by the use of tear gas canisters against residents during the raid. While the full extent of the property damage is still being determined, there have been no injuries reported.
amharic: ሰኞ ምሽት በኢየሩሳሌም አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው በቤት አናን ከተማ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ባደረጉት ወረራ ምክንያት የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። የአካባቢው ምንጮች እንደገለጹት እሳቱ የተቀሰቀሰው ወታደሮቹ ነዋሪዎችን ለመበተን በተጠቀሙበት የለቅሶ ጋዝ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የደረሰው የንብረት ውድመት በውል ባይታወቅም፣ እስካሁን በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Dilbata galgala magaalaa Yerusaalemitti dhihoo jirtu Beit Anan jedhamtutti, waraanni Israa'eel duula gaggeessaniin walqabatee ibidli ka'eera. Gabaasni naannichaa akka ibsutti, ibidli kun kan ka'e waraanni kun uummata irratti gaazii imimmaansuu fayyadamuu isaaniitiini. Hanga ammaatti miidhaan qabeenyaa gahuu isaa sirritti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, namni miidhame akka hin jirre ibsameera.
