title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
english: Russian politician Lev Shlosberg has been sentenced to over 11 years in prison for criticizing the invasion of Ukraine and speaking out against the military. The court convicted him of spreading false information and discrediting armed forces, charges he strongly denied as politically motivated. This ruling follows the broader suppression of the Yabloko party, which has now been barred from participating in upcoming parliamentary elections.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፖለቲከኛ ሌቭ ሽሎስበርግ በዩክሬን ላይ የተከፈተውን ጦርነት በመቃወም እና የጦር ኃይሉን በመተቸት ከአስራ አንድ ዓመት በላይ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ፖለቲከኛውን የሀሰት መረጃ በማሰራጨት እና ጦር ኃይሉን ስም በማጥፋት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ብሎታል። ይህ ውሳኔ እየተወሰደ ያለው የሩሲያ መንግስት ተቃዋሚዎችን ለማፈን በሚያደርገው እንቅስቃሴ ሲሆን የሽሎስበርግ ፓርቲ የሆነው ያብሎኮም በመጪው ምርጫ እንዳይሳተፍ ተከልክሏል።
oromo: Polaatiksiin biyya Raashiya Lev Shlosberg waraana Yukreen irratti labsame mormuu fi loltuu biyyattii komachuu isaatiin hidhaa waggaa 11 ol itti murteeffameera. Manni marichaa odeeffannoo sobaa facaase fi humna waraanaa maqaa xureesse jedhee kan isa yakke yoo ta'u, inni garuu yakka kana fudhachuu dideera. Murtiin kun kan darbe mootummaan Raashiya mormitoota isaanii ukkaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru keessatti yoo ta'u, paartiin isaa Yaablokoonis filannoo dhufu keessatti akka hirmaatu dhorkameera.

title: War on Iran: Phase II, Day 37
english: As the conflict involving Iran enters its 37th day, the government has placed a $30,000 bounty on American soldiers. Simultaneously, President Trump has decided to reduce military training exercises in South Korea. Meanwhile, members of the U.S. Congress are seeking clarification regarding the current living conditions of military personnel stationed at sea.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት 37ኛ ቀኑን በያዘበት ወቅት፣ የኢራን መንግሥት አሜሪካዊ ወታደሮችን ለሚገድሉ ወይም ለሚይዙ 30,000 ዶላር ሽልማት አዘጋጅቷል። በሌላ በኩል ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በደቡብ ኮሪያ የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ለመቀነስ ወስነዋል። የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የሕግ አውጭዎችም በባህር ላይ የሚገኙ ወታደሮች ስላሉበት የኑሮ ሁኔታ መንግሥት ማብራሪያ እንዲሰጥ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Iran waliin geggeeffamaa jiru guyyaa 37ffaa isaa irratti argama, mootummaan Iranis loltoota Ameerikaa ajjeesanii ykn qabanii dhufaniif badhaasa doolaara 30,000 qopheessee jira. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, Pireezidaant Traamp leenjii waraanaa biyya Koriyaa Kibbaa keessatti geggeeffamu hir'isuuf murteessaniiru. Gama biraatiin ammoo, miseensonni mana maree Ameerikaa haala jireenyaa loltoota garba irra jiraniirratti ibsi akka kennamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Somali army clashes with rebel forces for control of key city Baidoa
english: Somali federal forces successfully defended the city of Baidoa after a violent pre-dawn assault by local opposition fighters. The government military reported killing 30 rebels and accused them of collaborating with the extremist group al-Shabab during the attack. These ongoing power struggles, stemming from constitutional disagreements, continue to worsen the humanitarian crisis for displaced residents in the region.
amharic: የሶማሊያ የፌዴራል ጦር በባይዶአ ከተማ በአካባቢው ተቃዋሚ ታጣቂዎች የተሰነዘረውን ጥቃት በመመከት ከተማዋን መቆጣጠሩን አስታውቋል። የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴሩ በከባድ ውጊያው 30 ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውን እና ጥቃቱ ከአል-ሸባብ ጋር በመተባበር የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በሕገ መንግሥታዊ አለመግባባቶች የተነሳ የተቀሰቀሰው ይህ ግጭት በከተማዋ ለሚኖሩ ተፈናቃዮች የሰብአዊ ቀውስን እያባባሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Waraanni federaala Somaaliyaa magaalatti Baidoa irratti garee mormituu naannichaan ganama bariis baname ittisuun to'annaa isaa jala oolchera. Ministeerri ittisa biyyattii akka ibsetti, waraana cimaa taasifameen mormituu 30 ajjeefamuu fi gareen kunis garee al-Shabaab wajjin ta'uun weeraricha geggeessuu isaa beeksisera. Rakkoo seera bu'uuraa irratti hundaa'e kana irraa kan ka'e, walitti bu'iinsi uumame kun rakkoo namoomaa fi buqqaatii ummata naannichaa caalaatti hammaachiseera.

title: Hormuz traffic falls as transit through Bab al-Mandeb passage increases, says data firm
english: Data from the firm Kpler shows a sharp 19.5 percent decline in shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz last week due to mounting security risks. In contrast, activity at the Bab al-Mandeb Strait rose by 6.7 percent, with 254 vessels passing through. These shifts indicate that shipping companies are adjusting their routes in response to the changing conditions in the region.
amharic: የኬፕለር መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው ባለፈው ሳምንት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረግ የባህር ትራንስፖርት እንቅስቃሴ በ19.5 በመቶ ቀንሷል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በአካባቢው ሌላኛው ዋና የንግድ መስመር በሆነው በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል የሚደረግ እንቅስቃሴ በ6.7 በመቶ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል። ይህ ለውጥ የመርከብ ኩባንያዎች በአካባቢው ባለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ምክንያት የጉዞ መስመሮቻቸውን እየቀየሩ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon dhaabbata Kpler agarsiisuun, torban darbe daandiin galaana Hormuz imaltoota meeshaalee geejjibsiisan irratti hir’ina 19.5% agarsiiseera. Kana faallaa, daandiin galaana Bab al-Mandeb kan ta’e imaltoota meeshaalee 254 keessumsiisuun daballi 6.7% agarsiiseera. Jijjiiramni kun kan agarsiisu, dhaabbileen doonii adeemsa isaan irratti dhiibbaa nageenyaa mudateen walqabatee daandii isaanii akka jijjiiratan dha.

title: IRGC rejects Trump’s claims of talks with the US
english: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has officially dismissed President Donald Trump's assertion that they are engaged in negotiations with the United States. A spokesperson for the group labeled these claims as false, attributing them to American desperation. Furthermore, the official stated that any potential for future discussions is blocked by a lack of trust following previous American failures to honor international agreements.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ (IRGC) ከአሜሪካ ጋር ድርድር እያደረግን ነው የሚለውን የፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የቡድኑ ቃል አቀባይ እነዚህ መግለጫዎች ከእውነት የራቁ እና የአሜሪካን ተስፋ መቁረጥ የሚያሳዩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን ቃል ባለመጠበቃቸው ምክንያት ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር ለመነጋገር ምንም አይነት ዝግጁነት እንደሌለ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Itti gaafatamaan waraana Iran (IRGC) dubbii prezidaant Donald Traamp kan isaan Amerikaa waliin mari'achaa jiran jedhu guutummaatti haaleera. Dubbi himaan kun ibsa Traamp kijiba fi yaada of gowwoomsuu akka ta'e himuun, Amerikaan waadaa galtee diigdee waan beektuuf mariin tokkollee akka hin jirre ibseera. Kanaafuu, Iran Amerikaa waliin marii irratti argamuu ishee gadi jabeessee waakkateera.

title: Israel allows Jewish ritual at Al-Aqsa Mosque in unprecedented violation of status quo
english: Israeli authorities have officially permitted Jewish group prayers and the use of religious texts at the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in occupied East Jerusalem. This decision marks a major departure from the long-standing status quo that previously restricted such activities at the holy site. Palestinian officials have criticized the move as an unprecedented infringement on the established rules governing the mosque area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በአል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ ውስጥ የአይሁድ ቡድን ጸሎት እንዲደረግ እና የጸሎት መጻሕፍት እንዲገቡ በይፋ ፈቅደዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በቅዱስ ስፍራው ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የቆየውን መደበኛ አሰራር በእጅጉ የሚጥስ ነው። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት በጣቢያው ላይ ያለውን የተለመደ አሰራር የሚጻረር እና አደገኛ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el iddoo Masjiida Al-Aqsaa keessatti akka Ayhudoonni gareedhaan kadhatanii fi kitaabota kadhannaa fayyadaman seeraan hayyameera. Murteen kun lafa qulqulluu kana irratti waggoota hedduudhaaf hojii irra turee fi aadaa duraanii kan cabsu dha. Qaamoleen Falasxiin murtee kana kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, kunis iddoo kana irratti seera duraan ture kan jijjiiree fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: Kushner, Netanyahu agree on path forward for Gaza, Board of Peace official says
english: Jared Kushner and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have reached an understanding regarding the future of Gaza following a productive meeting. The agreement mandates that Hamas must be fully disarmed before any reconstruction or redeployment efforts can begin. Furthermore, the disarmament process is set to be overseen by an American general to ensure the transition is properly handled.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና እስራኤላዊው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ላይ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። በስምምነቱ መሰረት በጋዛ ውስጥ ምንም አይነት መልሶ ግንባታ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ሀማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ መፍታት አለበት። ይህ የትጥቅ መፍታት ሂደት በአሜሪካዊ ጄኔራል ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሚካሄድም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Jared Kushner fi Ministirri Muummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu gara fuulduraatti waa'ee Gaza irratti walii galtee irra ga'aniiru. Walii galtee kanaan, Gaza keessatti ijaarsi kamiyyuu utuu hin jalqabin dura gareen Hamas guutummaatti meeshaa waraanaa hiikuu akka qabu murtaa'eera. Akkasumas, adeemsi hidhannoo hiikkachuu kun hogganaa waraanaa Ameerikaan to’atamuun kan raawwatamu ta'a.

title: Democrats rebuke Trump over scaling back military drills with South Korea
english: President Trump is facing criticism from Democrats and some Republicans for unilaterally deciding to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea. Critics argue this move undermines a key security alliance and signals that American commitments are negotiable, potentially emboldening adversaries like China and Russia. Trump defended the decision by citing his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and South Korea's refusal to participate in the US-led effort against Iran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ የወሰኑት ውሳኔ በዴሞክራቶች እና በሪፐብሊካን አባላት ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። ተቺዎች ይህ ውሳኔ የአሜሪካን የረጅም ጊዜ የደህንነት ትብብር የሚያዳክም እና አገሪቱ ለጓደኞቿ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት ጥያቄ ውስጥ የሚከት ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ትራምፕ ውሳኔያቸውን የጠበቁት ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ባላቸው ግንኙነት እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ በአሜሪካ የሚመራው በኢራን ላይ የተደረገውን ዘመቻ ለመቀላቀል ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኗ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp marii waraanaa kan waliinii biyyoota lamaanii (US fi Koree Kibbaa) gadi xiqqeessuuf murtoo dabarsan irratti hoggantoonni paartii Dimokiraataas ta'e kanneen biroo mormii guddaa kaasaniiru. Mormitoonni murtoon kun michummaa nageenyaa cimaa jiru kan laaffisuu fi waadaa Ameerikaan biyyoota ollaa ishee wajjin seente kan shakkisiisu ta'uu dubbatu. Traamp murtoo isaanii kan ittiin falman, walitti dhufeenya isaan hoggantoota Koree Kaabaa wajjin qaban akkasumas Koreen Kibbaan duula Ameerikaan Iraan irratti gaggeessite keessatti hirmaachuu diduu ishee akka sababaatti kaasuudhaan.

title: How Russian dissidents are being punished by both Russia and Europe
english: Russian citizens who oppose their government are facing a difficult situation as they are being penalized by both Moscow and European nations. The Russian government has passed laws to restrict consular services and revoke citizenship for those living abroad who criticize the war. Simultaneously, many European countries are making it harder for these political exiles to obtain residency or asylum, leaving them in a precarious legal position.
amharic: የሩሲያ መንግሥትን የሚቃወሙ ዜጎች በሩሲያ እና በአውሮፓ አገራት በሁለቱም በኩል ከፍተኛ ጫና እየደረሰባቸው ይገኛል። የሩሲያ መንግሥት በውጭ አገር የሚኖሩ ተቃዋሚዎችን ፓስፖርት ከመከልከልና ዜግነታቸውን ከመቀማት ጀምሮ የተለያዩ ማዕቀቦችን እየጣለ ነው። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ፣ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የሸሹ የሩሲያ ተቃዋሚዎች በአውሮፓ አገራት የነዋሪነት ፈቃድ ወይም የጥገኝነት መብት ለማግኘት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ገብተዋል።
oromo: Lammiileen Raashiyaa mootummaa isaanii morman, mootummaa biyya isaanii fi biyyoota Awurooppaa lamaanuu biraa miidhaa cimaa irra gahaa jira. Mootummaan Raashiyaa lammiilee biyya ala jiran kanneen waraana kana morman tajaajila konsilaa dhorsuu fi lammiyummaa isaanii sarbuuf seera baasee jira. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, biyyoonni Awurooppaa baqattoota siyaasaa kanaaf hayyama jireenyaa ykn guca baqattummaa kennuu waan cimsaniif, lammiileen kun rakkoo seeraa cimaa keessatti kufanii jiru.

title: Rights group urges FIFA to block Infantino re-election bid over term limits
english: The human rights group FairSquare has officially requested that FIFA prevent Gianni Infantino from running for another term as president. They argue that he has already reached his three-term limit and that the previous decision to exempt his initial partial term was a violation of organizational rules. As the 2027 election approaches, Infantino is facing growing opposition from various football confederations and national associations regarding his leadership and financial proposals.
amharic: የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቹ ቡድን ፌር ስኩዌር (FairSquare) ፊፋ የጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን ቀጣይ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ እንዲያግድ ጠይቋል። ቡድኑ ኢንፋንቲኖ ቀድሞውኑ የሶስት ጊዜ የሥልጣን ዘመን ገደቡን እንደጨረሰ እና የቀድሞው የመጀመሪያውን የሥልጣን ዘመን የማይቆጥርበት ውሳኔ ሕገወጥ መሆኑን ይከራከራል። የ2027 ምርጫ ሲቃረብ፣ በተለያዩ የፊፋ አባል ድርጅቶች ዘንድ ስለ አመራሩ እና ስለ ፋይናንሺያል ዕቅዶቹ ያለው ተቃውሞ እየጨመረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Gumii mirga namoomaa FairSquare jedhamu, FIFA'n Gianni Infantino irra deebii prezidaantummaaf akka hin dorgomne dhowwu qaba jedheera. Isaanis akka jedhanitti, Infantino waggaa sadii qabachuun daangaa isaa guuteera, akkasumas murteen kanaan dura bara hojii jalqabaa isaa akka hin lakkaa'amne taasifame seeraan ala dha. Filannoon bara 2027 dhihaachaa waan jiruuf, hoogganaa FIFA irratti mormiin qaamolee kubbaa miillaa garagaraa fi biyyoota hedduu biraa dabalaa jira.

title: Police execute controlled World War II–era Mine explosion
english: Slovak authorities successfully detonated an old naval mine from the Second World War. The explosive was found in the Danube River after water levels dropped to an unusually low point. Bomb disposal specialists carried out the operation in a controlled manner to ensure public safety.
amharic: የስሎቫኪያ ባለስልጣናት ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ጊዜ የተረፈ የባህር ፈንጂን በተሳካ ሁኔታ አፈነዱ። ፈንጂው የተገኘው የዳኑቤ ወንዝ የውሃ መጠን በጣም በመቀነሱ ምክንያት ነው። የቦምብ አፈታት ባለሙያዎች ህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ፈንጂውን በተቆጣጠረ መንገድ እንዲፈነዳ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni nageenyaa biyya Slovaakiyaa, boombii yeroo waraana addunyaa lammaffaa keessa ture kan laggeen Daanebii keessatti argamee ture, to’annoo jala oolchanii dhukaasaniiru. Boombiichi kan argame sadarkaan bishaanii laga kanaa gadi bu’uun isaa mul’isuu hordofee dha. Ogeeyyiin boombii fashaleessan kun balaa ummata irra ga’uu danda’u hir’isuuf boombicha karaa qindaa’een dhukaasaniiru.

title: Trump demands Iran ‘put up the white flag of surrender’ as MoU expires
english: President Trump has called for Iran to surrender as a key agreement meant to de-escalate hostilities between the two nations has reached its expiration date. While acknowledging direct communication with the Iranian Revolutionary Guard, the president stated he is not pressured to finalize a deal before the upcoming midterm elections. Additionally, Trump issued a sharp warning to Oman, threatening military action if the country interferes with U.S. efforts to reopen the strategically important Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የነበረው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ማብቃቱን ተከትሎ ኢራን እጇን እንድትሰጥ ጠይቀዋል። ከኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ግንኙነት እንዳላቸው የገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ በአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ምርጫ ምክንያት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እንደማይቸኩሉ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ስትራቴጂያዊ ጠቀሜታ ያለውን የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ለመክፈት በሚደረገው ጥረት ኦማን ጣልቃ ከገባች የጦር እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስፈራርተዋል።
oromo: Prezidaant tiraamp, waliigaltee diinagdee fi siyaasaa gidduu biyyoota lamaanii xumuramuun isaa booda, Iraan harka kennachuu akka qabdu gaafataniiru. Ergamaa eegumsa jijjiiramaa Iraan wajjin quunnamtii qabaachuu isaanii kan ibsan prezidaantichi, filannoo biyyattii dhufuun wal-qabatee waliigaltee ariifachiisuuf fedhii akka hin qabne dubbataniiruu. Kana malees, karaa markabaa bakka murteessaa ta'e kan ta'e 'Strait of Hormuz' banuuf yaalii godhamu irratti, biyyi Omaan yoo harka keessa galte tarkaanfii waraanaa akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran issue
english: President Donald Trump has warned that the United States would attack Oman if the country interferes with American efforts to manage tensions with Iran. This threat follows reports that Oman is attempting to mediate the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping lane currently blocked by Iran. Meanwhile, Iranian officials have rejected Trump's claim that secret negotiations are taking place between the U.S. and the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኦማን ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን ግንኙነት ጋር በተያያዘ ጣልቃ ብትገባ አሜሪካ በኦማን ላይ ጥቃት እንደምትሰነዝር አስፈራሩ። ይህ የትራምፕ ማስፈራሪያ የመጣው ኦማን በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢራን የተዘጋውን የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ለመክፈት መካከለኛ ሚና እየተጫወተች ባለችበት ወቅት ነው። በሌላ በኩል የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ መካከል ድብቅ ድርድር እየተካሄደ ነው የሚለውን የትራምፕ መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doonaald Tiraamp biyyi Omaan dhimma Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru keessa yoo galte, Ameerikaan Omaan irratti haleellaa akka raawwattu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe Omaan daandii galaana Hormuz kan ammaan tana Iraaniin cufamee jiru banuuf giddu-galeessa ta'uuf yaalaa waan jirtuufi. Gama biraatiin, qondaalonni Iraan dubbii Tiraamp kan 'Ameerikaa fi waraana Iraan (IRGC) gidduu mariin dhokataa jira' jedhan haalaniiru.

title: US hiker dies after being struck by lightning on Mount Etna
english: A 30-year-old American tourist has died after being struck by lightning while hiking on Mount Etna in Sicily. Despite efforts by emergency responders to transport him to a hospital by helicopter, he was pronounced dead upon arrival. Authorities have cautioned hikers about the extreme dangers of sudden weather shifts and ongoing volcanic activity in restricted areas of the mountain.
amharic: በሲሲሊ በሚገኘው የኤትና ተራራ ላይ በእግር ጉዞ ላይ የነበረ የ30 ዓመት አሜሪካዊ ቱሪስት በመብረቅ ተመትቶ ሕይወቱ አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሠራተኞች ሰውየውን በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል ለማድረስ ጥረት ቢያደርጉም በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት ሆስፒታል እንደደረሰ ሕይወቱ ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል። ባለሥልጣናት በተራራው ላይ ባለው የእሳተ ገሞራ እንቅስቃሴ እና በድንገተኛ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት አካባቢው ለአደጋ የተጋለጠ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Turistiin Ameerikaa umriin isaa waggaa 30 ta'e tokko gaara Etna kan Siisilii keessatti argamu irratti yeroo adeemaa turetti bakakkaan rukutamee lubbuun isaa darbeera. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namicha xiyyaara xiqqaadhaan gara hospitaalaatti geeysuuf yaalii godhanis, hospitaala ga'uun isaa mirkanaa'ee du'eera. Abbootiin taayitaa bakkeewwan dhorkaa ta'an keessatti jijjiiramni qilleensaa tasaa fi hojiin gubataa turesuu isaa irraa kan ka'e, namoonni gaaricha irratti adeeman of eeggannoo guddaa akka taasisan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Iran signals readiness for ‘US ground operations’ as MoU expires
english: Iran has announced it may adopt a more aggressive military strategy against the United States following the expiration of a key security memorandum. Military officials warned that they are prepared to conduct offensive operations, including potential strikes on US-linked infrastructure, as tensions escalate over the Strait of Hormuz. This shift follows the consolidation of power by Iran’s Supreme Leader, who recently appointed hardline leadership to military positions to prioritize a stronger defensive and offensive posture.
amharic: ኢራን ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር የነበራት የፀጥታ ስምምነት መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ፣ ይበልጥ ጠበኛ የሆነ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቃለች። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ እየተባባሰ በመጣው ውጥረት ሳቢያ፣ የአሜሪካን መሰረተ ልማቶች ኢላማ በማድረግ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር መዘጋጀታቸውን አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ አቋም የመጣው የኢራን ጠቅላይ መሪ ለውትድርና አመራሮች ከፍተኛ ስልጣን በመስጠት፣ ሀገሪቱ ለጥቃትም ሆነ ለመከላከል ያላትን ዝግጁነት ለማጠናከር በወሰዱት እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Iraan waliigaltee nageenyaa Ameerikaa waliin qabdu erga xumuramee booda, tarkaanfii waraana cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta'uu ishee beeksifte. Qondaaltonni waraanaa akka jedhanitti, naannoo daandii galaana Hormuzitti dhiibbaan dabalaa waan jiruuf, bu'uuraalee misoomaa Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf qophii dha. Jijjiiramni kun kan dhufe hogganaan ol'aanaan Iraan hogganoota waraanaa cimaa ta'an bakka murteessaa irra kaa'uun, biyyattiin haleellaa ittisuufis ta'e haleellaa ofii raawwachuuf humna akka qabaattu taasisuun booda dha.

title: Boat sets sail from Bristol, aiming to break Israel’s siege of Gaza
english: A group of twelve activists has departed from Bristol, England, on a boat named 'Kate' to challenge the ongoing Israeli blockade of Gaza. This mission is part of the Global Sumud Flotilla, an initiative seeking to deliver humanitarian aid despite the high risk of interception by Israeli authorities. Participants, including a captain who was previously detained, aim to highlight the blockade's impact, even though most similar attempts in recent years have been stopped or seized.
amharic: አስራ ሁለት አክቲቪስቶች የጋዛን የኢስራኤል እገዳ ለመጣስ 'ኬት' በተሰኘች ጀልባ ከእንግሊዝ ብሪስቶል ከተማ ተነስተዋል። ይህ ጉዞ ግሎባል ሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ ከተባለው ዘመቻ አካል ሲሆን፣ አክቲቪስቶቹ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ለማድረስ እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ። ቀደም ሲል በኢስራኤል ኃይሎች ታስረው የነበሩ ካፒቴን እና አባላትን ያካተተው ይህ ቡድን፣ እገዳው የሚያስከትለውን ችግር ለአለም ለማሳየት ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ ተመሳሳይ ሙከራዎች በአብዛኛው በኢስራኤል እንደተከለከሉ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Hirmaattoonni kudha lama ta'an, markaba 'Kate' jedhamuun magaala Bristol, Ingiliizii ka'uun uggura Israa'el Gaza irratti kaa'ite cabsuuf imala jalqabaniiru. Sochiin kun 'Global Sumud Flotilla' jedhamu kan gargaarsa namoomaa dhaqqabsiisuuf karoorfate keessaa tokko dha. Gareen kun qondaaltota Israa'el irraa balaa harka butamuu fi hidhamuu jiraatuus, uggura kana mormuuf fi rakkoo jiru addunyaatti mul'isuuf jecha imala kana godhaniiru.

title: Lula and Bolsonaro’s son launch rival bids for Brazil presidency
english: The Brazilian presidential election has officially commenced, featuring a competition between the incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro. Lula is currently campaigning for his fourth term in office. His opponent, Flavio, is the son of the former president who is currently incarcerated.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ በይፋ መጀመሩን ተከትሎ ወቅታዊው ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ለአራተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን እየተወዳደሩ ነው። ሉላ የሚገጥሙት ደግሞ በአሁኑ ወቅት በእስር ላይ የሚገኙት የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ልጅ በሆኑት ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ነው። የሁለቱ ተፎካካሪዎች የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ በይፋ ተጀምሯል።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantummaa biyya Braazil seeraan kan eegale yoo ta'u, pirezidaantiin amma aangoo irra jiran Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva waamicha isaanii isa afraffaa argachuuf duula filannoo jalqabaniiru. Lula morkataan isaanii ilmi pirezidaantii kanaan duraa kan amma hidhaa keessa jiran Flavio Bolsonaro akka ta'an ibsameera. Wal dorgommiin kunis dhimmoota siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti xiyyeeffannaa guddaa argateera.

title: Global condemnation of Israeli settler violence against Palestinians
english: Pope Francis has voiced his opposition to the rising violence committed by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. This condemnation follows ongoing reports of settlers and soldiers attacking civilians, trapping families, and preventing the delivery of humanitarian aid. The situation has drawn widespread international concern regarding the safety and human rights of the Palestinian people.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ፍራንሲስ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በፓለስታይናውያን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ይህ ውግዘት የተከተለው ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች እና ወታደሮች በሲቪሎች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር፣ ቤተሰቦችን በማግለል እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዳይገባ በመከልከላቸው ነው። አሁን ያለው ሁኔታ የፓለስታይናውያንን ደህንነት እና ሰብአዊ መብት በሚመለከት ዓለም አቀፍ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pappasii Fransis qondaaltota Israa'el fi qindoomina isaanii giddugaleessa biyyaa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti namoota Falasxiin irratti gochaa jiran balaaleffataniiru. Balaaleffannaan kun kan dhufu, namoonni biyyaa fudhatan fi loltoonni siviilota irratti miidhaa geessisuu, maatiiwwan ugguruu fi gargaarsi namoomaa akka hin geenye dhorkachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Haalli kun jireenyaa fi mirga namoomaa namoota Falasxiin irratti yaaddoo guddaa addunyaa irratti uumee jira.

title: Why the Mecca Agreement has given the UAE-Israel alliance the jitters
english: The recently signed Mecca Joint Defence Agreement has caused significant concern among officials in the UAE and Israel, as it caught their intelligence agencies off guard. While the US and Israel previously expected Saudi Arabia to align with them against Iran, Saudi leadership opted for a different path, effectively distancing itself from the Western military camp. This shift suggests that regional powers are prioritizing new alliances over traditional Western partnerships following the failure of recent conflicts in Gaza and against Iran.
amharic: በቅርቡ የተፈረመው የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች እና በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል፤ ምክንያቱም ስምምነቱ የስለላ ተቋማታቸውን ባልጠበቁት ሁኔታ ነው ያገኘው። አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከእነርሱ ጎን በመሰለፍ በአንጻራዊነት በኢራን ላይ እንድትዘምት ቢጠብቁም፣ የሳውዲ አመራር ግን የተለየ አካሄድ በመከተል ከምዕራባውያን ወታደራዊ አጋርነት እራሱን አግልሏል። ይህ ለውጥ የሚያሳየው የክልሉ ሀገራት በጋዛ እና በኢራን ላይ በተደረጉት ግጭቶች የደረሰው ውድቀት ተከትሎ አዳዲስ ጥምረቶችን መፍጠር ላይ ትኩረት ማድረጋቸውን ነው።
oromo: Waliigalteen ittisa waliinii kan biyya Makkaatti mallattaa'e kun mootummoota UAE fi Israa'el biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera, sababni isaas qorannoon icciitii isaanii waa'ee kanaa duraa dursee beekuuf hin dandeenye. Ameerikaan fi Israa'el Sa'udii Arabiyaan Iran irratti isaan gargaarti jedhanii eeguu baatanis, hogganoonni Sa'udii karaa biraa filachuun quunnamtii waraanaa kan dhihaa waliin qaban laaffisuu filataniiru. Jijjiiramni kun kan agarsiisu biyyoonni naannichaa waraana Gaaza fi Iran irratti godhame erga fashaleen booda, tumsa haaraa uumuun faayidaa isaanii akka ta'e amanuu isaaniiti.

title: Israel formally allows Jewish prayer at Al-Aqsa Mosque in violation of status quo
english: Israeli authorities have officially authorized Jewish prayer within the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound, marking a major departure from the long-standing status quo that designates the site exclusively for Islamic worship. While Jewish visitors previously prayed there informally, this new policy allows for organized group prayer and the use of religious books under police supervision. Palestinian officials view this as an alarming escalation that undermines their administrative control and violates the international arrangements governing the holy site.

oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el iddoo masjiida Al-Aqsa keessatti akka Ayhudoonni sagada geggeessan hayyama isaanii kenneera. Kanaan dura sagadni geggeeffamu ture kan dhokataa fi dhuunfaa ture yoo ta'u, amma garuu poolisiin akka sagada gareen geggeeffamu hayyamuun isaa bulchitoota Masjiidichaa biratti mormii fi yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Pentagon signs multibillion-dollar Tomahawk deal amid missile shortage concerns
english: The Pentagon has secured a $22.9 billion agreement with Raytheon to rapidly increase the supply of Tomahawk cruise missiles. This decision comes as concerns grow regarding the depletion of US military stockpiles due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. These long-range weapons are essential for naval operations and will be manufactured at an accelerated pace to address current defense requirements.
amharic: የፔንታጎን ከሬቲዮን ጋር በ22.9 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የቶማሃውክ ሚሳይል ግዢ ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ከአይራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ምክንያት የአሜሪካ የጦር መሣሪያ ክምችት መቀነሱ አሳሳቢ ሆኖ በመገኘቱ ነው። እነዚህ ከባህር ሰርጓጅ መርከቦች እና የጦር መርከቦች የሚተኮሱ የረጅም ርቀት ሚሳይሎች፣ አሁን ያለውን የጦር መሳሪያ ፍላጎት ለማሟላት በፍጥነት እንዲመረቱ ይደረጋል።
oromo: Pentagoniin meeshaalee waraanaa gosa Tomahawk ariitiin argachuuf kambanii Raytheon waliin kontiraata biliyoona 22.9 dhuunfateera. Murtoon kun kan fudhatame walitti buiinsa Iraan waliin jiruun wal qabatee kuusaan meeshaa waraana Ameerikaa hir’achuu isaa hordofee dha. Missileonni fageenya dheeraa kanneen dooniiwwan lolaa irraa kan dhukaafaman yoo ta’u, fedhii waraanaa yeroo ammaa jiru guutuuf ariitiin kan oomishamudha.

title: Trump hails Mecca pact: Can it replace the region’s US security umbrella?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan recently formed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a new security pact that shifts focus toward regional self-reliance. President Donald Trump publicly supported this deal, viewing it as a positive step for allies to take responsibility for their own military needs rather than depending solely on the United States. While the agreement marks a significant change in geopolitical dynamics, analysts are questioning whether this partnership can truly replace the longstanding security support provided by the US.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በቅርቡ የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በመፈራረም የየራሳቸውን የክልል ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ የሚያስችል አዲስ ስምምነት አቋቁመዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህንን ስምምነት በደስታ የተቀበሉት ሲሆን፣ አጋር ሀገራት በአሜሪካ ላይ ብቻ ከመደገፍ ይልቅ የራሳቸውን መከላከያ በራሳቸው እንዲያጠናክሩ የሚያበረታታ እርምጃ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ስምምነት ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ቢሆንም፣ የሀገራቱ ህብረት በአሜሪካ የተሰጠውን የረጅም ጊዜ የጸጥታ ዋስትና ሙሉ በሙሉ ሊተካ ይችላል ወይ የሚለው ጉዳይ የባለሙያዎችን ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisaa 'Mecca' jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis mootummoonni kun nageenya naannoo isaanii ofiin akka eeggatan kan gargaaruudha. Preezidaant Doonaald Traamp tarkaanfii kana kan deggaran yoo ta'u, biyyoonni michoota ta'an kun gargaarsa Ameerikaa qofa osoo hin taane, ittisa biyya isaanii ofiin cimsuun akka isaaniif wayyu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, walii-galteen kun Ameerikaan naannichatti gahee isheen turte bakka bu'uu danda'a moo hin danda'u kan jedhu irratti qorattoonni gaaffii guddaa qabu.

title: Trump warns US will 'bomb shit out of' Oman if it strays from Washington's line on Iran
english: President Donald Trump has issued a stark warning that the United States would launch military attacks against Oman if it obstructs Washington's objectives regarding the Strait of Hormuz. This threat follows reports that Oman and Iran are coordinating on a maritime transit agreement for the region. Meanwhile, the Trump administration claims to be managing backchannel negotiations with both the Iranian Revolutionary Guard and Hamas to address ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳይ ከአሜሪካ ፍላጎት ጋር ከተቃረነ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደሚፈጽሙባት አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስፈራሪያ የተሰማው ኦማን እና ኢራን በክልሉ የባህር ጉዞ ላይ ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየሰሩ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። በተመሳሳይ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች እና በሀማስ በኩል ቀጥተኛ ድርድሮች እያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Donald Traamp, Oomaan dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti fedhii Ameerikaa kan mormitu yoo ta'e, weerara waraanaa cimaa akka ishee irratti banu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe, Oomaani fi Iraan daandii galaana naannichaa irratti waliigaltee gochuuf mari'achaa akka jiran gabaasamee boodadha. Gama biraatiin, mootummaan Traamp garee Iraan fi Haamaas wajjin marii icitii ta'e gaggeessaa akka jiru ibseera.

title: French Serie A footballer Yael Trepy in intensive care after near-drowning
english: French football player Yael Trepy is currently receiving intensive care at a hospital in Sassari following a near-drowning incident in a swimming pool. The 20-year-old Cagliari forward was reportedly rescued after ingesting a large amount of water in Porto Cervo and has been placed in a medically induced coma. His club is working closely with medical staff and his family while requesting privacy during this difficult time.
amharic: ፈረንሳዊው የካግሊያሪ እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች ያኤል ትሬፒ በሰርዲኒያ በሚገኝ መዋኛ ገንዳ ውስጥ በደረሰበት የመስጠም አደጋ ሳቢያ በሳሳሪ ሆስፒታል ከፍተኛ ክትትል ክፍል ውስጥ ይገኛል። የ20 ዓመቱ አጥቂ ብዙ ውሃ በመዋጡ ምክንያት ለህክምና በሰው ሰራሽ ኮማ ውስጥ እንደገባ ተዘግቧል። ክለቡ ከቤተሰቦቹ እና ከህክምና ባለሙያዎች ጋር በቅርበት እየሰራ ሲሆን የቤተሰቡን ግላዊነት እንዲከበር ጠይቋል።
oromo: Taphatoon kubbaa miilaa Faransaay Yael Trepy, daakaa daakoo keessatti balaa bishaan liqimsuu isa mudateen kan ka'e, amma hospitaala Sassari keessatti gargaarsa cimaa yaalaatti argama. Qalamaa (forward) waggaa 20 kan ta'e kun, bishaan baay'ee liqimsee erga lubbuun isaa oolfamee booda, doktaronni haala yaalaan hirriba itti fufiinsa qabu keessa galchaniiru. Kilabni isaa maatii isaa fi ogeeyyota fayyaa waliin ta'uun haala isaa hordofaa jiru, akkasumas yeroo rakkina kana keessatti iccitii maatii isaa akka kabajamu gaafataniiru.

title: Why Kushner met Hamas leaders, and what it means for Trump’s Gaza roadmap
english: US envoy Jared Kushner has held direct talks with Hamas leaders in Cairo to push forward a 15-point ceasefire plan for Gaza. Despite the US officially labeling Hamas a terrorist group, this meeting signals a shift in strategy, acknowledging the group's political influence. Kushner is now heading to Tel Aviv to pressure Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has so far resisted the American peace proposal.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነትን ለማስፈጸም ካይሮ ውስጥ ከሃማስ መሪዎች ጋር ቀጥተኛ ውይይት አድርገዋል። አሜሪካ ሃማስን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት ብትፈርጀውም፣ ይህ ስብሰባ የቡድኑን የፖለቲካ ተፅእኖ በመቀበል የተደረገ አዲስ የዲፕሎማሲ አካሄድ ሆኗል። አሁን ኩሽነር የአሜሪካን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ያደረጉትን የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁን ለማግባባት ወደ ቴል አቪቭ ያመራሉ።
oromo: Ergamtuun Ameerikaa Jaared Kushinar karoora dhaabbii waraanaa Gaazaaf qophaa'e deemsisuuf Kaayirootti hogganoota Hamaas waliin kallattiin mari'ataniiru. Ameerikaan Hamaas akka garee shororkeessaa ta'etti kan ilaaltu ta'us, mariin kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa gareen kun qabu beekamtii kennuun tarkaanfii haaraa fudhatamuu agarsiisa. Kushinar ammaa karoora nagaa Ameerikaa kanaan dura mormanii turan, muummee ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu amansiisuuf gara Tel Aviv deemaa jiru.

title: Cameroon celebrates after winning first ever WAFCON title
english: Cameroon is celebrating a major milestone after securing their first-ever Women's Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) championship title. The team achieved this historic victory by defeating Malawi with a decisive 3-0 score in the final match. The win has sparked widespread joy and national pride across the country.
amharic: ካሜሮን በታሪኳ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሴቶች የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ (WAFCON) ሻምፒዮን በመሆኗ በታላቅ ደስታ ላይ ትገኛለች። የካሜሮን ብሄራዊ ቡድን የመጨረሻውን ጨዋታ ማላዊን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ ታሪካዊ ድል አስመዝግቧል። ይህ ድል በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ደስታን እና የኩራት ስሜትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Kaameruun seenaa ishee keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf waancaa kubbaa miilaa dubartoota Afrikaa (WAFCON) injifachuu isheetiin gammachuu guddaa keessa jirti. Gareen biyyattii tapha xumuraa irratti Malaawwii 3-0 injifachuun injifannoo seena qabeessa kana galmeessiseera. Injifannoon kun biyyattii guutuu keessatti gammachuu fi boona guddaa uumee jira.

title: Iran bars two French diplomats from returning
english: Iran has officially prohibited two French diplomats from returning to the country following their recent arrest for alleged interference in internal affairs. While Iran claims the individuals violated diplomatic standards by engaging with civil society, France has condemned the incident as an illegal act of intimidation that ignores diplomatic immunity. Tehran is now demanding a formal apology from the French government regarding the diplomats' conduct.
amharic: ኢራን በቅርቡ በውስጥ ጉዳይ ጣልቃ ገብተዋል በሚል በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሁለት የፈረንሳይ ዲፕሎማቶች ወደ አገሪቱ እንዳይመለሱ ከልክላለች። የኢራን መንግስት ዲፕሎማቶቹ የዲፕሎማሲ ስነ-ምግባርን ተላልፈዋል ሲል ሲከስ፣ ፈረንሳይ በበኩሏ ይህ ድርጊት የዲፕሎማቲክ መብትን የጣሰ እና ማስፈራሪያ ነው ስትል አውግዛለች። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አሁን በዲፕሎማቶቹ ድርጊት ላይ ከፈረንሳይ ይቅርታን ጠይቋል።
oromo: Iiraan hojjettoota diippilomaasii Faransaayi lama kan kanaan dura dhimma keessoo biyyattii keessa seene jedhaman biyyattii akka hin deebine dhorkiteetti. Iiraan namoonni kun seera diippilomaasii cabsaniiru jechuun himattuus, Faransaayi garuu gochi kun mirga diippilomaasii cabsuu fi sodaachisaa dha jechuun balaaleffatteetti. Amma Iiraan gocha namoota kanaatiin walqabatee mootummaan Faransaayi dhiifama akka gaafatu barbaaddi.

title: UAE billionaire questions normalisation with Israel after Ben Gvir calls for nightly killings of Palestinians
english: Prominent Emirati billionaire Khalaf Ahmad al-Habtoor has publicly questioned the value of normalization with Israel following inflammatory remarks by Israeli Minister Itamar Ben Gvir. Al-Habtoor, who previously supported the Abraham Accords, expressed shock at Ben Gvir’s calls for the nightly killing of Palestinians in Gaza. His comments highlight a growing tension between maintaining diplomatic ties and the reality of the ongoing violence in the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ ቢሊየነር ካላፍ አህመድ አል-ሃብቱር የእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ የሰነዘሩትን የጥላቻ ንግግር ተከትሎ ከእስራኤል ጋር ስለተደረገው የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ጥያቄ አንስተዋል። ቀደም ሲል የአብርሃም ስምምነትን በጽኑ ይደግፉ የነበሩት አል-ሃብቱር፣ የቤን ግቪር ንግግር የሰላም ዕድሎችን የሚቃረን መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የኤምሬትስ ባለስልጣናት እና ነጋዴዎች ከእስራኤል ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት በተመለከተ ያለውን ውስጣዊ መረበሽ አመላካች ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Biliyeeneriin biyya UAE beekamaa ta'e Khalaaf Ahmad al-Habtoor, ibsa cimaa ministeera Israa'el Itamar Ben Gvir godhaniin walqabatee hariiroo Israa'el wajjin jiru irratti gaaffii kaasaniiru. Namni kun kanaan dura waliigaltee 'Abraham Accords' deggeraa turus, amma garuu haasaa Ben Gvir kan namoota Gaza keessatti guyya-guyyaan ajjeesuu barbaadu jechuun isaa amanachuu akka isa dhibe ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun, walitti dhufeenyi dippiloomaasii Israa'el wajjin jiru rakkoo naannichaa wajjin walitti bu'aa jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi military ship in Red Sea
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels recently claimed to have launched missile attacks against a Saudi military ship and its escorts in the Red Sea. Saudi officials have not yet addressed these claims, which follow a recent deadly attack on a vessel near the critical Bab el-Mandeb strait. These incidents occur amidst ongoing tensions and the Houthis' stated intent to block Saudi maritime activities in the region.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በኤርትራ ባህር ውስጥ የሳዑዲ አረቢያ የጦር መርከብንና አጃቢዎቿን በሮኬት መታን ሲሉ አስታውቀዋል። የሳዑዲ መንግስት እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት መግለጫ አልሰጠም። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በባብ ኤል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ ከጥቂት ቀናት በፊት በተፈጸመ ሌላ ገዳይ ጥቃት ማግስት ሲሆን፣ ሁቲዎች በአካባቢው የሳዑዲ መርከቦችን እንቅስቃሴ ለመግታት እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Finniiltonni Houthi kan Yaman, qondaalonni Saudi Arabia doonii waraanaa fi kanneen ishee eegan irratti galaana diimaa keessatti miizayiliin haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Saudi Arabia hanga ammaatti gabaasa kana irratti kan hin ibsine yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun kan dhufu jireenya namaa kan galaafate haleellaa guyyoota muraasa dura naannoo Bab el-Mandeb tti raawwatamee booda. Houthiinis imala doonii Saudi Arabia naannichatti danquuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli settlers paralyse Palestinian nurse in West Bank shooting
english: A 26-year-old Palestinian nurse named Muhammad Mutoor was left partially paralyzed after being shot in the back by Israeli settlers in the West Bank town of Sa'ir. Mutoor was attempting to provide medical assistance to residents during a violent settler attack when he was targeted. Due to settlers blocking access to the area, he faced significant delays in reaching a hospital, and medical professionals believe he is unlikely to regain the use of his lower limbs.
amharic: ሙሐመድ ሙቱር የተባለ የ26 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ነርስ በዌስት ባንክ ሳኢር ከተማ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተተኮሰበት ጥይት አካሉ ሽባ ሆኗል። ነርሱ በወቅቱ በቦታው የነበሩ ጉዳተኞችን ለመርዳት ሲሞክር ነበር በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ጀርባውን የተተኮሰበት። ሰፋሪዎቹ አካባቢውን በመዝጋታቸው ምክንያት ተጎጂው ወደ ሆስፒታል ለመድረስ ከፍተኛ ችግር የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ የደረሰበት ጉዳት ከባድ በመሆኑ ዳግም የመራመድ ዕድሉ እጅግ አናሳ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: gargaaraa fayyaa lammii Paalastayinii kan ta'e Muhammad Mutoor jedhamu, magaalota Gumbii dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti haleellaa seettaraa Israa'elootaan raawwatameen dugda isaa rukutamee qaamaan hir'ateera. Muhammad, namoota haleellaa sanaan miidhaman gargaaruuf yeroo deemu akka rasaasaan rukutame ibsameera. Seettaroonni daandii waan cuqalanif gara hospitaalaa geessuun isaa baay'ee kan ulfaate yoo ta'u, miidhaa cimaa irra ga'een akka inni itti fayyadama miila isaa deeffachuu hin dandeenye ogeeyyiin fayyaa ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Like a battlefield’: How Yemen’s Mocha went from a town of fishermen to a city of fighters
english: The Yemeni coastal city of Mocha has transformed from a quiet fishing port into a strategic military hub dominated by the Republican Guard. Since the civil war, many people fleeing Houthi-controlled regions have moved there for work, turning the city into a central base for forces led by Tareq Saleh. Recently, the area has faced intense attacks from Houthi fighters, resulting in significant civilian casualties and forcing many residents to move their families to safer locations.
amharic: የየመን የባህር ዳርቻ ከተማ የሆነችው ሞቻ ከቀድሞው ጸጥተኛ የአሳ አስጋሪ መንደርነት ወደ ወታደራዊ ማዕከልነት ተቀይራለች። የእርስ በርስ ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ በኋላ ከሁቲ ቁጥጥር ስር የሸሹ ብዙ ሰዎች ለስራ ወደዚህች ከተማ በመምጣታቸው፣ ከተማዋ በታሬቅ ሳሌህ የሚመራው የሪፐብሊካን ጥበቃ ጦር መኖሪያ ሆናለች። በቅርቡ በከተማዋ ላይ እየደረሱ ያሉት የሁቲ ጥቃቶች በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎችን ለህልፈት የዳረጉ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎችም ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ወደ አስተማማኝ ቦታ ለማዛወር ተገደዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan qarqara galaana Yemen, Mocha, ganda qurxummii qabuu irraa gara bakka waraanaa guddaa tokkootti jijjiiramteetti. Waraana siviilii booda, namoonni yeroo baayyee naannoo Hutiin to'atamuu irraa baqatan gara magaalaa kanaa waan dhufaniif, amma buufata waraana Republican Guard kan Tareq Saleh hogganamu taateetti. Yeroo dhihoo as, weerarri Hutiin magaalaa Mocha irratti raawwatan lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu kan galaafate yoo ta'u, jiraattonnis maatii isaanii gara bakka nageenya qabutti baqachiisuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Yemen’s drone war: Rivals flex growing aerial muscle
english: The conflict in Yemen has entered a new phase as both Houthi rebels and government forces increasingly rely on drone warfare. While the Houthis continue to use long-range strike drones, the government has begun deploying its own remote-controlled aircraft to target rebel positions. Experts view this shift as a significant tactical development that is changing how the decade-long war is being fought on the ground.
amharic: የየመን የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ሁለቱም ተፋላሚ ወገኖች ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላኖችን (ድሮኖችን) በስፋት መጠቀም በመጀመራቸው አዲስ ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሷል። የሁቲ አማፂያን የረጅም ርቀት ድሮኖችን በመጠቀም ጥቃቶችን ሲያደርሱ፣ የመንግስት ኃይሎችም በአንጻሩ የራሳቸውን ድሮኖች በማሰማራት የአማፂያኑን አቋቋም እያጠቁ ይገኛሉ። ይህ የቴክኖሎጂ አጠቃቀም በአስር አመታት የዘለቀውን የየመን ጦርነት ስልት እየቀየረ መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen haala haaraa keessa galeera; kunis gareen Houthii fi mootummaan Yemenis waldorgommii waraana xiyyara nama hin feene (drones) irratti qaban dabaluu isaatiin kan dhufedha. Houthiin xiyyaroota fagoo dhaqqaban fayyadamaa yoo jiraatan, mootummaan immoo ofiisaa dhimma itti ba’uun bakka waraanni Houthii jiru rukutaa jira. Jijjiiramni teeknoolojii kun waraana Yemen kan waggaa kudhan lakkoofsise irratti dhiibbaa guddaa fiduufi dandeettii waraantummaa garee lamaanuu jijjiiruu akka danda'u ogeeyyiin ni ibsu.

title: Trump scales down war games with South Korea: Why it matters
english: President Donald Trump has directed the Pentagon to significantly reduce annual joint military exercises with South Korea. He justified this decision by citing his positive personal relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and his frustration that South Korea declined to support the U.S. in its conflict with Iran. While the drills will still proceed, the scale of the operations will be notably decreased.

title: Will Europe hear a landmark Russian climate change case?
english: A group of activists recently challenged the Russian government at the European Court of Human Rights, arguing that its failure to address climate change is destroying the traditional lifestyles of indigenous groups like the Yukaghir. Despite the lawsuit highlighting how rising temperatures are disrupting ecosystems in Siberia, the court dismissed the case without providing a clear explanation. The plaintiffs remain disappointed by this decision, especially since similar climate-related cases have been accepted by the court in the past.

title: Israel’s religious right is changing the state from within
english: Ultra-Orthodox and religious-nationalist groups in Israel are increasingly influencing government institutions to promote fundamentalist values. By working through the existing political system rather than seizing power by force, these factions are pushing for greater religious authority, expanding gender segregation, and securing more public funding for religious education. This shift is deeply affecting the nation's democratic character and further entrenching the existing inequalities faced by Palestinians.

english: The article criticizes the U.S. government for imposing visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, arguing that this move prioritizes political convenience over true justice. title: Jason Arday’s death is institutional murder
english: Jason Arday, a history-making Black professor at the University of Cambridge, passed away shortly after resigning from his position following a relentless public campaign against him. Critics from across the political spectrum targeted him with accusations of plagiarism and personal ridicule, which many argue were rooted in systemic racism and opposition to diversity initiatives. Despite investigations finding no evidence of academic misconduct, the intense media scrutiny and harassment he faced have been described as a form of institutional cruelty.

title: US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding expires: How and why it fell apart
english: A peace agreement signed by the United States and Iran in June has expired without achieving its goals. Although the deal was intended to stop military actions and facilitate negotiations, ongoing conflicts, disagreements over shipping rights, and continued hostilities in the region caused it to collapse. Despite the mediation efforts, the broader war remains unresolved as both nations continue to trade attacks.

english: Arsenal enters the 2026-27 season as the reigning Premier League champions, aiming to secure back-to-back titles for the first time in nearly a century. The team has bolstered its roster with new signings like Bruno Guimaraes, though they face a significant challenge due to William Saliba’s long-term injury. After narrowly missing out on the Champions League title last year, the club is highly motivated to finally claim Europe's top trophy.

title: Trump orders US to scale back South Korea military drills
english: President Trump has directed the United States military to reduce the scope of joint training exercises with South Korea. title: Trump says US could bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’
english: Donald Trump has issued a warning to Oman, stating the U.S. could take military action against the nation if it interferes with Washington's peace objectives regarding Iran. The situation highlights ongoing tensions as both countries work to finalize their strategic transit plans in the region.

title: Trump contradicts Vance on top US goal in Iran war
english: President Donald Trump has identified preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons as the administration's primary objective. This stance appears to clash with Vice President JD Vance, who previously stated that prioritizing affordable fuel prices for Americans was the administration's main focus. Trump emphasized that stopping Iran's nuclear ambitions remains his top priority, overriding the economic concerns mentioned by his vice president.
